Alchemists are masters of tinctures, concoctions and\s
infusions. They can prepare themselves set infusions from\s
potions that replicate the effect - without consuming inventory\s
space or being in danger of shattering. They are reasonably good\s
at melee, especially with the right potions, though they cannot\s
rival melee specialists.\s
Even bad potions are useful in their hands, as weapons or\s
ingredients. Their other abilities include creating copies\s
of potions and turning items to gold. They require intelligence\s
for some of their abilities.\n
Archers are to bows what warriors are to melee. They are the best\s
class around with any bow, crossbow, or sling. They need a lot of\s
ammunition, but will learn how to make it from junk found in the\s
dungeon. An archer is better than a warrior at stealth,\s
perception, searching and magical devices.\n \n
Archers have a class power - 'Create Ammo' - which creates pebbles\s
or shots from rubble, and arrows and crossbow bolts from bones.
The Archaeologist is an erudite treasure hunter, seeking out the most valuable\s
prizes that the dungeon has to offer. At home in subterranean caverns and vaults,\s
he is rarely lost or snared in traps. His powers of perception and detection are\s
very great, as is his skill with arcane devices. At high levels he can use the\s
dark magic of the entombed Pharaohs. The powers of the Archaeologist are enhanced\s
by Wisdom.
Bards are traditional musicians, and songs and sound are the\s
foundation of their magic. Four songbooks are available to a Bard,\s
two of them sold in towns. Some songs are over in a quick yelp,\s
consuming no more time than a magic spell would; but most continue to be\s
sung, with continuing effects, until the bard either chooses to stop or\s
runs out of mental energy. A bard can only ever sing one tune at\s
a time. The primary spell stat of a bard is Charisma.
Beastmasters see the fierce creatures of the world as opportunities rather than threats, and their\s
riding skills are almost unparalleled. Between their class powers and access to Trump magic,\s
they have many ways to summon or charm living creatures to serve as\s
their hands and feet. Beastmasters are some of the best shooters outside archery specialists, and their\s
melee skills are good enough to get by on. Charisma determines the spellcasting prowess of a Beastmaster.
Beornings are a hardy, northern race of men, renowned for their ability\s
to assume the shape of a bear. Bear-formed Beornings greatly resemble\s
Berserkers: they are extremely strong in melee and very hard to kill, but\s
incapable of reading scrolls, casting spells or using magical devices.\s
Man-shaped Beornings are still stronger in combat than a regular human,\s
but somewhat lacking in magical skills.\n\nThe equipment slots available\s
to a Beorning depend on their shape, and like Werewolves, they carry a\s
special satchel for keeping the items not needed in their current shape.
A Berserker is a fearful fighter indeed, immune to fear and\s
paralysis. At high levels, Berserkers can reflect bolt spells\s
with their tough flesh. Furthermore, they can remove cursed equipment\s
by force, and their special combat techniques are not affected by\s
anti-magic barriers. Berserkers cannot, however, use any magical devices\s
or read any scrolls, and are hopeless at all non-combat skills. To\s
offset these great disadvantages, they gain an important class power -\s
'Recall' - very early.
Armageddon is the most deadly offensive realm. You won't be lacking for firepower here.\s
However, every spell is an offensive spell, so this realm suffers from a lack of any\s
utility spells.
The books of Rage describe various techniques. To learn a new technique, you must perform a ritual of rage, destroying the book in the process.
\sOnce learned, you may use techniques without requiring the corresponding Rage book, but you will need to find many copies of each book in order
\sto learn all of the techniques.
Burglary is the preferred realm of rogues, allowing them to specialize in what they do best: Stealing!\s
This realm offers good detection and escapes, offers talents for picking pockets and setting traps,\s
and even allows for direct assassination of sleeping monsters. The books for this realm are only\s
available in the Black Market (or in the dungeon).
'Protection Rate' means how much damage is reduced by your armor.\n
Note that the Protection rate is effective only against normal\s
'attack' and 'shatter' type melee attacks,\s
and has no effect against any other types such as 'poison'.\n \n
'Dodge Rate' indicates the success rate on dodging the\s
monster's melee attacks.\s
It is depend on the level of the monster and your AC.\n \n
'Average Damage' indicates the expected amount of damage\s
when you are attacked by normal melee attacks with power=60.
Create a potion of blood. Player is limited to 30 such potions, and may neither\s
drop, throw nor sell them. Quaffing a potion of blood heals 100hp and cures\s
blindness, confusion, poison and stuns.
Blood-Knights are fighters who have delved into the dark arts and can perform\s
some special offensive effects using their own health. In addition to the\s
HP cost, using such an ability causes bleeding, with an amount proportional\s
to the cost of the ability. These special abilities rely on Constitution.\n \n
Blood-Knights are very unusual in that cuts and low health make them more powerful; at\s
full health their melee is nothing special, but the more damaged and wounded they are,\s
the faster and deadlier their attacks become. On the\s
brink of death they are the strongest fighters imaginable, and stories of their\s
legendary feats abound; but with great power comes great risk of death,\s
and you don't recall ever meeting one of these heroes of legend in person!\n \n
Blood-Knights, like Blood-Mages, receive reduced benefits from healing magic.\s
Since a Blood-Knight relies on their own blood for their power, this class is restricted\s
to certain races; no non-living race may walk the red path.
A Blood-Mage is similar to a normal mage in his selection and\s
variety of spells, but differs in that he has no separate\s
mana pool; instead, spells are powered by hit points.\s
Moreover, due to the Blood-Mage's abnormal constitution,\s
all healing is much less effective than normal; indeed, Blood-Mages\s
completely eschew healing spells to not disrupt the flow\s
of blood that is the essence of their power. They shun the realm of\s
Life as anathema to all they hold sacred.
Blue-Mages, like all mages, rely on magic rather than muscle;\s
but they are unique in the way they gain new spells, as they\s
learn from monsters rather than books. Blue-Mages' primary\s
spellcasting stat is Intelligence.\n \n
A Blue-Mage can learn and cast monster spells, summons, and even\s
ranged attacks as their own spells; this technique is called Blue magic.\s
Blue-Mages remember their spells permanently, but to learn a spell they\s
must be directly hit by it while their 'Learning' class power is\s
active. Because of this requirement, Blue-Mages never learn spells like\s
Haste or Healing that affect the monster itself.
Cavalry are masters of horsemanship and enjoy riding to battle. Being good at\s
both melee and archery, they take pride in their overwhelming offensive strength\s
on horseback; but spellcasting is a closed book to them, and magical devices\s
difficult to use. High-level Cavalry learn to forcibly saddle and\s
tame wild monsters with their 'Rodeo' class power.
Chaos-Warriors are the feared servants of the terrible Demon Lords\s
of Chaos. Every Chaos-Warrior has a patron demon, who may give him\s
a reward on level-up; the Chaos-Warrior may be healed or polymorphed,\s
have his stats increased, or be rewarded with an awesome weapon.\s
On the other hand, though, he might be severely punished or simply ignored by\s
the patron; the Demon Lords of Chaos are unpredictable indeed, although\s
rewards are thankfully more common than punishments. The exact reward\s
will not depend on anything the player does, and is up entirely to\s
random chance and the patron; each patron gives out different rewards\s
and punishments.\n \n
Chaos-Warriors select one spell realm, either Chaos or Daemon; they have\s
no interest in other forms of magic. They can learn every spell in\s
their chosen realm. At level 40 they gain the powerful ability to emit\s
confusing lights, with the potential to stun, scare and confuse every creature in sight.

The term demigod is commonly used to describe mythological figures whose one\s
parent was a god and whose other parent was human; as such, demigods are\s
human-god hybrids and are quite powerful. Demigods receive special abilities\s
depending on their parentage.
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of love, beauty, pleasure, and procreation.\s
You inherit her sex appeal. As such, your pets are more obedient and shopkeepers\s
fawn over you in their efforts to please you. You may kiss monsters and they\s
might even decide to follow you with slavish devotion, though sometimes this\s
just angers them.
Apollo has been variously recognized as a god of light and the sun,\s
truth and prophecy, medicine, healing, plague, music, poetry, arts,\s
archery, and more. You inherit powers of illumination and are completely\s
immune to light based attacks. You are seldom blinded.
Ares is the bold son of Zeus and Hera, whose very name is feared and respected\s
by warriors and citizens alike. His legendary combat prowess exceeds that of\s
Zeus and Poseidon, but he is less skilled in wiles than the other Olympians.\s
You inherit exceptional bonuses to combat and have a firm grip on your strength.\s
Later in life, you will be able to fly into a berserk rage on command. However,\s
your lust for combat decreases your stealth as you call out challenges\s
to all that you meet. And your resistance to magic is suspect as well.
Artemis was often described as the daughter of Zeus and Leto, and the\s
twin sister of Apollo. She was the Hellenic goddess of the hunt, wild\s
animals, wilderness, childbirth, virginity and young girls, bringing\s
and relieving disease in women; she often was depicted as a huntress\s
carrying a bow and arrows. You inherit powers of archery and are very\s
nimble. Your skills with the bow are unmatched and you shoot arrows\s
with increased range and deadliness.
Athena is the great goddess of wisdom and the protector of Athens. She was\s
born of Zeus and the Titan Metis, and her cunning far surpasses that of the\s
other deities. You inherit great clarity of thought and magic and will be\s
able to cast spells more reliably than other mortals. And should you fail to\s
cast a spell, you will pay a reduced casting cost rather than the full amount.\s
You also have a firm grip on your mental prowess.
Demeter is the goddess of the harvest, who presided over grains, the\s
fertility of the earth, and the seasons. You gain powers of regeneration,\s
healing, and temperance. Eventually, you will become resistant to the\s
ravages of time.
Hades is Ruler of the Underworld. You gain resistance to nether forces,\s
increased fortitude and have a firm grasp on your life and health.
Hephaestus was the god of technology, blacksmiths, craftsmen, artisans,\s
sculptors, metals, metallurgy, fire and volcanoes. Like other mythic smiths\s
but unlike most other gods, Hephaestus was lame, which gave him a\s
grotesque appearance in Greek eyes. He served as the blacksmith of the\s
gods. You inherit powers of enchantment and protection. Your equipment\s
will not suffer diminution by corrosion or magical attack.
Hera was the wife and one of three sisters of Zeus. Her chief function\s
was as the goddess of women and marriage. You inherit great clarity of\s
mind and capacity for magic. You are very wise and have a firm grasp on\s
your magical energy, which is even augmented.
Hermes, the Messenger, is the extremely cunning diplomat used by the Olympians\s
to negotiate truces. With his Winged Sandals and his powerful magic, there\s
is no place barred from him, and there is no way to detain him. You inherit\s
great powers of motion and will never become slowed. Your stealth is better\s
than your brethren and your speed will increase with experience.
Poseidon, Brother of Zeus, is Lord of the Seas and Storm. You inherit\s
elemental protection and corrosive attacks that melt the armor of your foes.
Zeus, King of the gods and ruler of Mount Olympus, is god of the Sky\s
and Thunder, and nominal husband of Hera. You inherit increased stature\s
and your divine birth will be marked by your aura of electricity. You also\s
resist lightning.
Devicemasters are excellent with magical devices, but poor in most other skills.\s
They may shoot or use melee in a pinch, but this will never be their forte; instead,\s
they conquer through their arsenal of magical devices.\n \n
Each Devicemaster chooses to specialize in a particular class of devices, and will\s
gain extra bonuses for speciality items. These bonuses include increased\s
damage, increased speed of activation, extra resistance to charge draining,\s
and even the ability to occasionally power these devices without consuming charges;\s
each of these abilities becomes stronger with experience. In addition, speciality devices\s
are easier to use, although all Devicemasters are also good with devices of other types.\n \n
Devicemasters have several useful device-related powers; they may detect magical devices from\s
a distance, and gain the powerful talent of Recharging very early on.\s
At higher levels, they gain the ability to move effects from\s
one device to another, or to move magical essences from one item to another if they specialize\s
in Potions or Scrolls. In times of desperate need, the Devicemaster may drain a speciality item\s
of multiple charges at once; this greatly increases the power of the\s
effect, but may destroy the device in the process.
It has unpredictable effects when you quaff it, either\s
1) curing 5000 HP and all temporary ailments,\s
2) increasing all stats, 3) decreasing all stats,\s
4) providing temporary light speed,\s
5) temporarily turning your skin to stone,\s
6) giving or curing mutations randomly,\s
7) repeatedly giving or curing mutations randomly,\s
8) temporarily making you gigantic,\s
9) triggering the Baby Foul Curse,\s
10) temporarily polymorphing you into an Ent,\s
11) making you hallucinate temporarily,\s
12) curing 420 HP and all ailments but making you\s
hallucinate temporarily,\s
or 13) exploding in your mouth for 11d66 damage,\s
massive stunning and a dangerous wound.
Trusted followers of mysterious ancient spirits known as the 'Purples',\s
the Disciples roam the world running errands for their masters,\s
learning mighty spells and receiving rare items as rewards for their\s
work. There are three main flavors of Purple Disciples - disciples\s
of Karrot, disciples of Yeqrezh, and disciples of a group of\s
Purples known as the Troika. Each of the Purples expects different\s
things of their Disciples, and each helps them achieve their ends in\s
very different ways.
Doppelgangers are truly pathetic creatures. While nobody has actually ever seen\s
their true form, they are rumored to be small, plain, pathetic creatures.\s
Their one saving grace is the ability to mimic other races.
The duelist is the ultimate one-on-one fighter, but finds himself at a severe\s
disadvantage when facing numerous strong foes at once. To start a duel, the duelist\s
first issues a challenge to his intended foe; of course, this will wake the monster\s
up, as there is no honor in dueling a sleeping enemy! And while the duelist will\s
honor the fight as a one-on-one affair, many monsters have no such scruples.\n \n
Against a challenged foe the duelist is extremely strong, gaining bonuses to saving\s
throws, armor class, damage reduction and combat prowess. On the other hand, due\s
to the single-mindedness of their focus, the duelist is quite vulnerable to unchallenged\s
opponents. Most of the special techniques of this class aim at enforcing the sanctity of the\s
duel.\n \n
The duelist only ever gains a single attack in combat, but they make the most of this\s
blow by gaining enhanced effects as they gain experience. Able to wound, stun, and even\s
hamstring their foes, the prowess of the duelist in a one-on-one encounter is legendary!\n \n
Duelists favor light armors and weapons, and cannot equip a shield. They gain no extra bonus for\s
wielding a weapon with both hands. For their techniques, the duelist relies on Dexterity.

a runaway slave of this dark pit's demonic masters. Your attempts to\s
gather supplies for your escape have been detected, and now everybody\s

A Force-Trainer is a master of the spiritual Force. They prefer\s
fighting with neither weapon nor armor. They are not as good\s
fighters as are Monks, but they can use both magic and the\s
spiritual Force. Wielding weapons or wearing heavy armor disturbs\s
use of the Force. Wisdom is a Force-Trainer's primary stat.\n \n
Force-Trainers use both spellbook magic and the special spiritual\s
power called the Force. They can select a realm from Life,\s
Nature, Craft, Death, and Crusade. To use The Force, you select\s
it just as if it were spellbook 'F'; which means you need to press\s
'm' and then 'F' to select the Force. The most important spell of\s
the Force is 'Improve Force'; each time a Force-Trainer activates\s
it, their Force power becomes more powerful, and their attack\s
power in bare-handed melee fighting is increased temporarily. The\s
strengthened Force can be released at one stroke when a\s
Force-Trainer activates some other Force spell, typically an attack\s
spell. They have a class power - 'Clear Mind' - which allows them\s
to rapidly regenerate their mana.
The Gray-Mage casts spells from memory rather than books; a\s
spellbook is only required for the initial learning process.\s
However, only ten spells may be memorized at any given time; and\s
while a Gray-Mage may replace old spells with new ones, the total\s
number of spells they can study is limited.\n\n
Gray-Mages do not choose specific realms like book spellcasters;\s
instead, they choose a general bias towards either Good, Neutral\s
or Evil magic. So while all Gray-Mages may learn spells from the Arcane,\s
Armageddon, Chaos, Craft, Sorcery and Trump realms, only a Good Bias allows\s
access to Life and Crusade magic; only a Neutral Bias allows access to Nature\s
magic; and only an Evil Bias allows access to Death and Daemon magic. At any one\s
time, a Gray-Mage has relatively few spells directly at their disposal; but their ability\s
to pick the best spells from an extremely large pool more than compensates for this.\s
As with most mages, the key stat is Intelligence.
A Hex-Mage is precisely what the name suggests: a mage\s
between the warrior and mage classes. While their brothers, the\s
rangers, specialize in Nature magic and survival skills, true\s
Warrior-Mages attempt to reach the best of both worlds. As\s
warriors they are much superior to the usual Mage class.\s
Intelligence determines a Warrior-Mage's spell casting ability.\n \n
Warrior-mages begin the game with Arcane magic, and they can\s
freely select another realm of magic. Although they do not gain\s
new spells as fast as regular mages, they will eventually learn\s
every spell in both realms, thus making them a very competitive\s
choice for players who appreciate Arcane magic. They have two\s
class powers - 'Convert HP to SP' and 'Convert SP to HP' - which\s
allow them to heal HP using mana or gain mana using HP.
High-Mages are mages who specialize in one particular field of\s
magic and learn it very well - much better than an ordinary mage.\n\n
For the price of giving up a second realm of magic, High-Mages\s
gain substantial benefits in the mana costs, power, minimum levels, and\s
failure rates of the spells in their speciality realm. They are also the\s
only class able to cast Hex spells. High-Mages have a class power -\s
'Eat Magic' - which absorbs mana from wands, staves, or rods; although\s
this power is not available to those who choose the Hex realm. Their\s
primary spellcasting stat is Intelligence.

The epitome of a self-made man, an Igor is generally easily recognizable by\s
the ring of stitches around his neck, the tendency to limp with perfectly\s
healthy legs, and the mysterious ability to appear suddenly\s
and then disappear when the mob comes looking. An Igor is\s
at home with lightning, and always carries a bag full of ice in case he\s
should find something that needs to be kept cold.

Karrot is a proud and ambitious Purple, convinced that it is his destiny\s
to one day rule the universe; but rather than getting personally involved,\s
he has assigned to his Disciples the task of eliminating any potential\s
rivals (like the Serpent of Chaos). Being so sure of his greatness, Karrot\s
sees little reason to vary his habits and is the only one of the Purples to\s
predictably teach all of his Disciples the same spells. Karrot occasionally\s
assigns side-quests to his Disciples, with the dual aim of testing their\s
mettle and removing lesser threats to his supremacy. These side-quests only\s
appear on fairly challenging levels; they can be avoided by sticking to\s
safer areas, but this will not make Karrot happy...\n\n
Karrot considers many artifacts to be his rightful personal property, and\s
will claim them immediately if you should find them. He will, however, give\s
you another artifact as a reward for your discovery. These replacement\s
artifacts tend to start out as fairly weak, but eventually become very\s
strong as you gain Karrot's respect by leveling up and by successfully\s
completing side-quests. If you're really lucky and do a particularly good job,\s
you might even receive the ultimate gift - Urog, Karrot's legendary blade of\s
shadows!\n\n
Disciples of Karrot tend to play as fighter-mages, relying on melee, spells\s
and devices alike. They are unique among Disciples in not having a mana pool;\s
casting a spell takes a toll on their hit points instead. They are also the only\s
Disciples to have a charming spell - but the greatest of Karrot's followers\s
are rumoured to eventually learn even rarer abilities...\n
Karrot's disciples depend on Intelligence to make their spells work.
Known for his unsurpassed expertise in the mysterious realm of Law,
\sthe Lawyer has a comprehensive skillset that allows him to set and
\sdetect traps, to slow or mystify his enemies, to quietly escape or
\savoid dangerous fights, to acquire knowledge about the world around
\shim, and to make friends and influence people. As he relies on his
\sfamiliarity with Law and with tricks and approaches that have
\sworked in the past, the lawyer uses Wisdom as his spellcasting stat.
A Mage is a spellcaster who must live by his wits, as he cannot\s
hope to simply hack his way through the dungeon like a warrior.\s
A Mage always carries his spellbooks with him, but also relies\s
on magical devices, which he can master easily. The primary\s
spellcasting statistic of a Mage is Intelligence.\n\n
Mages have few restrictions in choosing and learning spells;\s
they can freely choose any two realms when a character is created,\s
although their natural inclinations make Life magic fairly hard to learn.\s
See <link:magic.txt> for more information on magic, realms and book spellcasting.
The Magic-Eater can absorb magical devices. Once absorbed,\s
these devices will function like normal objects and can be\s
used whenever charges are available. In effect, it is as\s
if the Magic-Eater had extra inventory slots for devices.\s
However, absorbed magic can not be drained the way normal\s
devices can, nor can these objects be destroyed. The number of\s
slots for each kind of device is limited, and the Magic-Eater\s
will need to choose which object to replace once the slots are\s
all used. Absorbed magic cannot be recharged through scrolls,\s
spells, potions or activations; the Magic-Eater must rest to\s
regain charges. The rate at which absorbed devices recharge\s
is affected by Regeneration.
The Mauler favors extremely heavy weapons, and possesses powerful abilities whose\s
effectiveness depends on the weight of the weapon. While they only gain a limited\s
number of blows which can never be magically increased, they are capable of\s
hitting opponents exceptionally hard to make the most of each strike. Maulers\s
must wield a single weapon with two hands for their talents to\s
function properly.
Turns your skin to stone and provides temporary resistance to the elements.\s
More resistances are given at higher levels.
At low levels, generates a ball of psionic energy centered on you.\s
At level 25 and above, inflicts psionic damage on all monsters in line of sight.
Removes fear and stunning. Gives heroism and speed. Heals HP a little unless\s
you already have heroism and temporary speed boost.
Fires a ball which damages monsters and absorbs their mind power.\s
A successful absorption also consumes some of your own energy, costing an additional 0.01 to 1.50 turns.
Mindcrafters rely not on book magic, but on the powers of the mind.\s
These mind powers are specific to this class, and range\s
from extrasensory perception to psychic attacks and the mental domination\s
of others. Most mind powers become accessible fairly early, but gain in\s
strength with more experience. Wisdom determines a Mindcrafter's ability to\s
use mind powers.\n \n
Mindcrafters' combat skills are reasonably good but far from outstanding;\s
a combination of physical and mental attacks often works better\s
for them than either one alone. A seasoned mindcrafter is very hard to\s
confuse, and can effortlessly detect the minds of others. Mindcrafters\s
have a class power, 'Clear Mind', which allows them to rapidly regenerate\s
Mirror-Masters are spellcasters; like mages, they must live\s
by their wits. They can create magical mirrors, which they use to\s
support their special Mirror-Magic spells. Intelligence determines a\s
Mirror-Master's spellcasting ability.\n \n
Mirror-Masters gain more spells with experience, and their spells also\s
become more powerful over time. Much of their magic relies on the\s
careful placement of mirrors, which can be used for both offense\s
and defense. Mirror-Masters' abilities are also enhanced by standing on a mirror;\s
for example, they can perform quick teleports from there or rapidly regenerate their mana.\s
Nevertheless, not all Mirror-Magic requires a physical mirror; many effects\s
rely simply on light or mirror-shards, or on uncertainty, reflection and illusion.\s
The maximum number of Mirrors which can be controlled simultaneously depends\s
on the player's level; sometimes, unnecessary mirrors may need to be broken.
Monks are very different from most other classes in that they prefer\s
to fight unarmed; while they can use a few select weapons reasonably\s
well, their training in martial arts makes them more powerful with\s
no weapons. Monks also gain bonuses from empty armor slots; to gain the\s
resistances necessary for survival, some kind of armor will still be\s
eventually needed, but if the armor is too heavy it will severely\s
disturb the Monk's martial arts maneuvers. As the Monk gains levels, more\s
powerful forms of unarmed attack will become available, and the defensive bonuses\s
for having empty armor slots likewise increase.\n\n
The various sects of monks are devoted to different areas of\s
magic; they select one realm from Life, Nature, Craft, Trump and Death.\s
Wisdom determines their spellcasting ability.\n\n
Monks have two class powers, 'Assume a Posture' and\s
'Double Attack'; they can choose different postures for\s
different situations, and use powerful combinations of attacks for\s
the finishing blow.
Mystics are masters of bare-handed fighting, like Monks. Unlike Monks, though, they\s
do not learn normal spells; instead, they gain mystical powers with experience,\s
and these powers directly influence their martial arts. In this respect,\s
Mystics are somewhat similar to Samurai; indeed, they even concentrate to boost\s
their mana like the Samurai. Mystics eschew weapons of any kind, and require\s
the lightest of armors in order to practice their martial arts. As with other\s
martial artists, their attack speed depends on their level and Dexterity; their\s
mana and fail rates, though, are influenced by Charisma. Mystics are in tune with\s
the natural forces around them, and may even summon animals to their aid when\s
necessary. It is whispered that mystics have discovered a way to kill an opponent\s
with a single touch; but they do not share this knowledge with novices.
A Necromancer attempts to gain both power and knowledge through\s
communion with the dead. They rely on the special realm of Necromancy to\s
summon aid from the dead, whether directly in terms of undead\s
servitude, or indirectly through otherworldly knowledge. Necromancy\s
also offers many foul offensive spells; but all of these require direct\s
physical contact, and so need an empty, gloveless hand to work.\s
Yet this handicap is a cheap price to pay for the ability to kill a foe with\s
one deadly touch!\n\n
Necromancers forever hunt for the legendary Eye and Hand of Vecna\s
to complete their power.
A Ninja is a fearful assassin lurking in darkness. He or she can\s
navigate effectively with no light source, catch enemies by surprise,\s
and kill with a single blow. Ninjas can use Ninjutsu, and are\s
good at locating hidden traps and doors, disarming traps and\s
picking locks. Since heavy armors, heavy weapons, or shields will\s
restrict their motion greatly, they prefer light clothes, and\s
become faster and more stealthy as they gain levels. A Ninja\s
knows no fear and, at high level, becomes almost immune to poison\s
and able to see invisible things. Dexterity determines a Ninja's\s
ability to use Ninjutsu.\n \n
A Ninja can use Ninjutsu for lurking and surprise attacks. They\s
gain more Ninjutsu techniques as they gain levels. They have a\s
class power - 'Quick Walk' - which makes their walking speed\s
extremely fast.
The Ninja-Lawyer moves silently in the night, combining the\s
stealth, agility and offensive power of the ninja with the\s
subtle practical tools of the lawyer. Ninja-Lawyers, like\s
specialist ninjas, prefer light armour and stabbing weapons and\s
acquire the powerful 'Quick Walk' class power. A ninja-lawyer\s
relies on both wisdom and dexterity, requiring the former for\s
legal tricks and the latter for ninjutsu.
A Paladin is a combination of a warrior and a priest. Paladins excel\s
as melee fighters, but are only middling in ranged combat; their\s
stealth, perception, and device skill are likewise mediocre,\s
though their divine alliance gives them a decent saving throw. Wisdom\s
determines a Paladin's success at praying to his deity.\n \n
Paladins can select a realm from Life, Crusade, Daemon and Death.\s
Like priests, they cannot select which prayers to learn, but are\s
rewarded with new prayers by their deities. They can learn all spells,\s
but not as fast as priests. They detest paganism so strongly that they\s
even gain experience for destroying high-level pagan spellbooks:\s
'pagan' means Life or Crusade spellbooks for a Death/Daemon\s
Paladin, and all spellbooks other than Life or Crusade for a\s
Life/Crusade Paladin. Paladins receive one class power, 'Holy Lance'\s
or 'Hell Lance', depending on the alignment of their realm.
Chaotic adventurers are servants of the Demon Lords of Chaos, and\s
often receive a reward - or punishment - from their patrons when\s
they gain a level. Their strengths and weaknesses are\s
unpredictable; even their stat bonuses are subject to change.
Combative adventurers favor melee and shooting at the expense\s
of other skills such as disarming, device-skill, or saving throw;\s
yet this personality has more subtlety to it than the raw, untempered\s
muscle of Mighty.
A Craven person is a coward, preferring to avoid a fight at any\s
cost. Craven adventurers shoot and use devices well, their\s
stealth is impressive, and they can move fast when not fighting;\s
but their stats and other skills are somewhat wanting.
Being Fearless raises your melee skills and force of personality, besides helping you\s
resist fear; but your constitution and hit points are negatively affected.
As a Fragile adventurer, you lack both self-confidence and physical toughness.\s
Due to your incredibly low stamina, you are quickly exhausted by melee,\s
or ranged combat, or magical combat, or any other strenuous activity. (Maybe you\s
should just stay at home, quietly reading some book that isn't too heavy.)
A Hasty person endeavors to do all things quickly. Speed,\s
rather than skill or care, is paramount, and the Hasty\s
adventurer moves quickly through the dungeon, bungling much.
A Lazy person has no good stats and can do no action well.\s
All fail rates are negatively impacted. Yet some whisper\s
that the less hard you work, the greater the reward...
A Lucky adventurer has poor stats but, surprisingly, can do all\s
things well. For some reason, good things seem to happen\s
more often to lucky players.
Mighty raises your physical stats, skills and stamina, but reduces\s
your magical abilities and gives a slight penalty to your spell\s
fail rates. It is the most warrior-like personality.
The Munchkin personality is for players who love being overpowered.\s
It raises all your stats and skills; with this personality, you can\s
beat the game easily, but gain no honor in doing so, and your win\s
won't count.
Mundane adventurers have few talents to speak of, and\s
are incapable of using spells and not very good with\s
magical devices; but their anti-magic allows them to\s
resist the effects of many dangerous curses.
Nimbleness is good for your skills and allows you to move less noisily; but your\s
raw strength is somewhat lacking, and you cannot survive quite as many hits.
As a Noble person, you have the benefits of an upper-class upbringing\s
(at least, you consider them benefits). You start with extra\s
money, and seem to have a relatively easy time acquiring even\s
more money; but whether other aspects of the adventuring life\s
will come to you as naturally remains to be seen.
An ordinary person is average in every respect, gaining neither\s
skills, talents nor stat adjustments.
A Patient adventurer does everything with great care, but not always\s
with great speed or confident hands. Patient characters are highly\s
resilient, and their slow but measured movements make them relatively\s
Pious deepens your faith in your God. It makes your physical\s
ability average, and your stats suitable for a priest.
Sexy adventurers have excellent stats and skills, but their haughty\s
attitude aggravates all monsters.
Being Shrewd does not give you an impressive physique, but good device handling\s
embiggens the smallest man; this is the stereotypical Mage personality,\s
yet can also help a warrior complement his weaknesses.\s
Shrewdness has a direct positive influence on spell fail rates.
Sneaky adventurers are stealthy and at home with light stabbing\s
weapons; but face-to-face combat with heavier weapons plays\s
against their strengths.
You have multiple personalities, and inherit the upsides and\s
downsides of each. At all times, one of your personalities is\s
dominant, and you receive the full effects of that personality;\s
the remaining personalities are either partially suppressed\s
or fully suppressed. A partially suppressed personality gives\s
reduced stat and skill bonuses, and some other effects\s
(like the walking speed bonus of Craven or the aggravation from\s
Sexy) will be absent entirely, but other parts of the personality\s
apply normally. A fully dormant personality has no effect on you\s
at the moment, but may resurface later! Level gains, and the\s
trauma of taking heavy damage, can cause previously suppressed\s
personalities to become dominant and vice versa.
An Unlucky adventurer looks impressive on paper and\s
should, by rights, have an easy time - but somehow\s
their fights don't go quite so smoothly, and the items\s
they most need never seem to drop.
Politicians are masters of spinning and manipulation, seeking\s
to convert others to their cause and to destroy those they cannot\s
convert. They are not very good at either direct combat or at using\s
magical devices, and rely on their savvy and special skills and on\s
the help of their friends to win fights. They have the ability to\s
toggle between hit points, wealth and experience as the source of\s
their power, although the latter two only become available at higher\s
levels. Charisma is a key stat for Politicians.
A Priest is a character devoted to serving a higher power. They\s
explore the dungeon in the service of their God. They are fairly\s
familiar with magical devices, which they believe act as foci for divine\s
intervention in the natural order of things.\n \n
There are two types of priests: Good and Evil. If the priest chooses Life\s
or Crusade as their first realm, they will follow the path of good;\s
as such, they may not choose an evil realm for their second realm. Good\s
priests abhor bloodshed, and therefore are not comfortable with edged weapons,\s
although they eventually learn to bless such weapons and then use them without disrupting their prayers.\s
Should a priest choose Death or Daemon as their first realm, however,\s
they will serve an evil god; evil priests actually enjoy shedding blood, and\s
suffer no such weapon restrictions. Of course, evil priests abhor good things,\s
and are unable to choose Life or Crusade for their second realm.\n \n
Good priests have a strong affinity for Life prayers, and learn them very well, even better\s
than a High-Mage. Conversely, evil priests favor prayers of Death, and receive\s
strong bonuses when choosing this foul realm. Otherwise, priests learn magic less\s
efficiently than a Mage would; but their greater stamina and combat skills compensate for this.\s
Priests, unlike Mages, cannot choose to study specific spells; rather, they\s
are granted new prayers by the whim of their deity, presumably in accordance with\s
some greater divine plan. The primary stat for a priest is Wisdom.
Mana Thrust grants you an offensive ranged attack.\s
With this power, you will have good early offense as well as the\s
ability to scale the damage of the mana thrust quite considerably.\s
No monster can resist the Mana Thrust; but unlike Energy Blast this\s
attack is a bolt, so it only affects a single monster at a time and\s
some monsters might reflect the spell back.
Energy Blast grants you an offensive ranged attack.\s
ability to scale the damage of the blast quite considerably.\s
The blast will produce an elemental ball whose type is of your\s
choosing, although the range of choices will depend on how\s
much focus you invest in the blast. Unlike most ball spells,\s
this spell deals full damage to all monsters in its area of effect\s
unless resisted, without any reduction away from the epicenter.
Psionic Seeing grants you considerable powers of detection.\s
Depending on how hard you focus, you may detect monsters, traps,\s
doors, stairs, and objects; with enough concentration you can\s
map your surroundings, gain temporary powers of telepathy, or even\s
map the entire level!
Weapon Grafting is a power unique to the psion. Invoking this power\s
fuses your current weapon to your arm for a limited time; in a sense,\s
your weapon becomes an extension of you and may be wielded much more\s
effectively. However, while this spell is active, you will not be\s
able to remove your weapon.
Psionic Clarity focuses the mind of the psion. While only active for\s
a short while, this power lowers the casting costs of all other psionic\s
powers, which can be quite useful later in the game; take it as an early\s
option if you already have an eye on the endgame and have no need for more\s
immediate returns.
Psionic Blending grants great powers of stealth. While active, you\s
will be able to blend in with your surroundings and sneak up on many foes.\s
With maximal focus, you may even suppress aggravation (from your equipment),\s
though your stealth will still be somewhat disrupted.
Psionic Shielding is a defensive power. While active you will gain Free Action\s
as well as increased Armor Class; Free Action provides resistance to deadly\s
paralysation attacks, while Armor Class makes monster melee attacks much\s
more likely to miss and also reduces damage from some melee attack hits.
Psionic Travel grants a wide array of teleportation powers. From inexpensive short-range\s
'blinking' to long-range escapes, you will have it all. Indeed, with great\s
focus you will even be able to control your teleportation and choose where you land!
Psionic Protection is a defensive power. While active you will gain resistance to\s
the elements (Fire, Cold, Lightning, Acid and Poison). The more of your mental\s
focus you devote to this power, the more of these elements you will resist.
Combat Transformation is an offensive power, channelling your mental focus into\s
enhanced melee fighting. While active, your skills in combat will improve, affecting\s
the accuracy of your blows; also, your reflexes will quicken in line with your mental\s
acuity, affecting the speed of your attacks. This power requires your constant\s
focus, and so increases the casting costs of all other psionic powers.
Archery Transformation is an offensive power, channelling your mental focus into\s
enhanced shooting. While active, your skills with all missile weapons will improve,\s
affecting the accuracy of your shots; sufficient skill also allows you to shoot\s
with increased speed. This power requires your constant focus, and thus\s
increases the casting costs of all other psionic powers.
Ego Whip is an offensive power which lashes a targetted monster repeatedly with your\s
psychic energy; the effect lasts for multiple rounds, during which time you may\s
perform other separate actions. However, monsters do get a saving throw against\s
the ego whip every turn, and if they make a save, they are able to shake off the\s
whip completely.
Psionic Speed channels your mental energy into speed of motion, granting great\s
powers of haste. With increased focus comes increased speed, and the total\s
amount of haste can greatly exceed what is possible for other classes.
Psionic Healing is a recovery spell. By focusing your mind, you will be able\s
to heal your wounds, cuts and stunning; with sufficient focus, you can cure\s
hallucination and even restore your stats.
Brain Smash is an offensive spell. Although it does no physical damage, it inflicts\s
a powerful mental attack on your foes which may confuse, stun or slow them.
Mind Wave unleashes the effects of your mental focus on all visible monsters as psionic energy,\s
dealing unresistable raw damage and potentially stunning, confusing, frightening and paralysing\s
monsters; as the attack operates directly against monsters' minds, these side effects can sometimes bypass\s
normal resistances, but mindless monsters are not affected at all. This spell does not pack quite as\s
much raw power as Psionic Storm, but the lower cost and ability to affect more monsters compensate for this.
Psionic Crafting channels your mental focus into an object, enchanting it in the\s
process. With maximal focus, you can even craft excellent items!
Psionic Storm unleashes your mental focus in a large, powerful ball of energy;\s
this psionic energy not only deals unresistable damage, but can stun, confuse,\s
frighten and even paralyze monsters, with a chance to bypass normal resistances.\s
Mindless monsters are not affected.
Psionic Backlash is a defensive spell. While active, any enemy that damages you will\s
take a proportional amount of damage in retaliation; the greater your focus, the\s
greater the retaliatory damage.
Psychic Drain allows you to draw mental energy and focus from the magic around you.\s
Whenever you are hit by a magic spell you will convert some of the damage into mana. This\s
power has no effect on non-magical damage like breaths, rockets or melee.
Psionic Disruption allows you to block the minds of others, hindering their ability\s
to cast spells. But be warned: innate monster attacks (such as breaths, rockets and\s
boulder throws) will not be affected!
Mental Fortress grants immunity to Dispel Magic and Anti-Magic. In addition, it\s
increases the power of your spells.
Psionic Foresight allows you to see into the future. With knowledge\s
of events before they take place, you will be able to avoid many attacks\s
altogether!
Psions, like Mindcrafters, rely on their innate mental powers; indeed, some of these\s
powers resemble those of Mindcrafters. Unlike Mindcrafters, though, Psions can\s
select which powers they wish to learn; together with their natural aptitude\s
in a fairly broad range of skills, this makes Psions one of the most versatile\s
classes. Most psionic powers are extremely strong, but the number of powers a\s
Psion can learn is very limited: one each at levels 1, 10, 15, 20, 30, 35, 40 and 50.\n\n
The potency of psionic powers can be scaled up or down as needed, within limits;\s
the more mana is spent, the more powerful the effect. All psionic powers require\s
great concentration, leaving the Psion no time for pets.\s
Psions do not have one fixed spell stat; they can use either Intelligence, Wisdom\s
or Charisma, whichever is the highest. In this respect they are truly unique!
