Angels are heavenly beings on a holy mission. Their wings allow them to\s
fly over chasms and pits. They are rarely fooled by invisibility, and\s
become resistant to the elements as they mature. Their stats are truly awe-inspiring,\s
and their divine magic extremely strong, offering good offense combined with detection,\s
healing, melee enhancement and utility. Angels are one of the most powerful\s
races, but they also gain levels extremely slowly.\n \n
Angels have a humanoid body type; they use the same equipment slots as most normal\s
player races, and have no innate melee attacks. Wisdom is their primary spell stat.
Centipedes are natural creatures with many legs. As they\s
evolve, they change colors, but not much else seems to differentiate the various forms.\s
Perhaps you prefer blue to red or green? Eventually, once you have evolved into your\s
ultimate evolutionary form, you will be able to change colors at will and thereby become\s
very powerful indeed.\n \n
As a centipede, your main survival attribute will be the many pairs of boots you can wear.\s
Hopefully, this will be enough.
Demons are powerful servants of evil and come in many forms. They rely on their\s
devilish powers or their brutish strength to survive.\n \n
The various demonic races include the Balrogs, powerful demons of fire; the Servants\s
of Khorne, mighty warriors of destruction; the Tanar'ri, weaker demons whose ultimate\s
form has three sets of arms, but prefers to fight naked; and Cyberdemons, whose firepower\s
is unsurpassable.\n \n
Demons cannot eat normal food, but must feast upon the remains of their human\s
enemies. They are unaffected by the Eldritch Horror.
Khorne's servants come in many forms and are powerful forces of melee. They know nothing\s
save melee, and strike at all that dare oppose the will of their master. As they gain\s
experience, Khorne rewards his servants with new and more powerful forms.
Tanar'ri were originally slave demons, but rose up to overthrow their masters.\s
They generally take on a humanoid form and are classic demons full of malice and\s
cruelty. The ultimate form for this demon is the Marilith, a female demon with\s
three sets of arms and a serpent body capable of attacking with six melee weapons!
Balrogs are demons of shadow and flame. Their evil knows no bounds. Their spells are\s
the most powerful of all demonkind, and at very high levels they may even call forth\s
fires directly from hell.
Cyberdemons are giant humanoid forms, half demon and half machine. They are a bit\s
slow and move erratically, but their immense bodies and unsurpassable firepower\s
more than make up for this. The walls of the dungeon reverberate with their heavy steps!\n\n
Cyberdemons are one of the very few monster races not to undergo evolution, and so almost all\s
their might is available from the beginning, although they do gain even more\s
strength later on and their offense becomes stronger with experience.
Dragons are powerful winged serpents. They are strong in combat,\s
with razor-sharp claws and a bone-crushing bite; but even more legendary\s
is their breath, which grows ever more deadly as the dragon matures.\n \n
Due to their non-humanoid bodies, dragons are unable to wear armor, gloves\s
or boots; however, being creatures of magic, they may equip up to six rings.\s
They can also wear a helmet, a light source, a cloak and an amulet. Because\s
of these equipment restrictions, dragons may have a difficult time covering\s
all resistances; but each dragon has at least one innate resistance, maybe\s
even an immunity.\n \n
Dragons begin life in a weak form, being very young. As their bodies mature,\s
their scales grow tough and their claws sharp. Their breaths become stronger and\s
stronger, and they frequently gain additional magical powers and resistances.\s
All dragons can fly, but younger dragons are not so quick as their elders.\n \n
With the exception of Steel Dragons, who are far less intelligent than their kin\s
and rely on brute force only, each dragon may choose to specialize in a\s
specific type of magic. These special dragon-magic realms do not require books\s
to learn. The selection of a realm has a direct influence on the stats and skills of the dragon.
Dragons specializing in lore are seekers of knowledge. They are the most\s
intelligent of dragonkind, and it is intellect that drives their magic.\s
Armed with a vast array of detection and knowledge spells, dragons of lore\s
seek power through knowledge. They eventually gain powers of telepathy and\s
automatic object identification. Lore dragons are quick learners, and gain\s
maturity much more rapidly than the rest of their kind.
Dragon breath is the stuff of legends, and this realm seeks to enhance this most\s
powerful attribute of dragonkind. With this speciality, you will be able to shape\s
and control your breaths to maximize deadliness for a given situation. In addition,\s
dragons of this realm may choose their breath types if applicable, and breathing\s
becomes less costly as they mature. This focus requires great fortitude to master\s
and somewhat diminishes the dragon's defenses and melee.
Attack dragons seek melee supremacy above all else. This realm offers powerful attack\s
spells to support a race that is already among the melee elite, and the result tends to be\s
devastation and death. With this realm, the dragon may rend their opponents with\s
extra sharp claws, may snatch an adjacent opponent in their powerful jaws and then\s
toss them about like a rag doll, and may even augment their bite attacks with their\s
breath element! A rampaging dragon is a truly awe-inspiring sight, one that is\s
seldom witnessed, or perhaps just seldom survived. This focus values strength above all else.
The most powerful magical items have long been believed forged by dragonflame. The\s
craft dragon gains powers of enchantment, and may even reforge artifacts into the objects\s
of their choosing! Otherwise, craft dragons are not particularly powerful, as they trade\s
melee and breath prowess for magical understanding. This focus requires great wisdom.
Dragon scales have thwarted many a would-be dragonslayer. Naturally tough and resistant,\s
the dragon's armor is even further enhanced by this realm. This specialization gives enhanced\s
armor class, reflection, resistance to cuts and stunning, resistance to poison\s
and life draining, and sustaining of several key stats, albeit not all at once. With all\s
of these extra innate bonuses, the magic spells of this realm are few in number but serve\s
to offer temporary defensive augmentations. Unlike their kin, dragons of this order prize\s
agility above all else.
All dragons have a formidable presence and make fearsome opponents; but Domination dragons\s
are truly a breed apart, seeking to bend and control the will of all they meet. Convinced\s
of their right to rule, these dragons may subjugate the weak, terrify the uncertain,\s
and stun the unwary with their awesome presence. They are the best dragons at controlling\s
minions, and can summon mighty aid. Initially hostile monsters summoned to battle may switch sides\s
when they notice whom they have been commanded to fight; and in the end, the dragon of\s
domination may sever all oaths of allegiance, returning enemy summons to where they came from.\s
Needless to say, dragons of this order value force of will above all else.
Crusade dragons are on a mission to destroy the forces of evil. As such, this realm is only\s
available to Gold Dragons and Law Dragons. Being of a single focus, the Crusade dragon is not\s
as powerful in melee or breaths as other dragons, but their spells more than make up for this\s
deficit, at least against evil opponents. Crusade dragons can breathe holy elements\s
not normally accessible. At the sight of evil, they become enraged and may haste\s
for battle. They can even heal a bit; and ultimately they may smite the forces of evil with\s
holy power, both in melee and in breath. Strong in personality, dragons of this order\s
may summon like-minded kin for the final battles.
Death dragons are enemies of life itself, seeking to destroy all living creatures. With this\s
realm, the dragon may bend their breath weapon to suit their necromantic desires, eventually\s
breathing mastery over both death and life. At high levels, the death dragon's melee attacks\s
gain a powerful draining effect against living creatures. This focus values strength above\s
all else. This foul realm is only available to Shadow and Chaos dragons.
Red Dragons are elemental dragons of fire, and the second-strongest fighters among\s
dragons. Their fiery breaths are the stuff of legends with damage unsurpassed. Even their\s
bites are likely to burn their opponents, further enhancing their deadliness in melee.\s
As the Red Dragon matures, it becomes more and more resistant to fire, eventually gaining\s
total immunity.
White Dragons are to cold what Red Dragons are to fire. Their melee is awe-inspiring,\s
and their icy breath can be felt even in their bite. Together with Red Dragons, they\s
have the deadliest breaths among dragonkind; and they become more and more\s
resistant to cold as they mature, eventually attaining immunity.
Blue Dragons are elemental dragons of lightning. Their breaths are as\s
strong as those of their Red and White brethren, their melee somewhat weaker but still mighty,\s
and their bites eventually shock their foes. Blue Dragons become more and more\s
resistant to lightning as they mature, eventually gaining total immunity.
Black Dragons are to acid what Blue Dragons are to lightning. Their breaths are as strong\s
as those of their Red, White and Blue kin; and fewer monsters resist acid, giving them an extra\s
opening. As the Black Dragon matures, its bites become corrosive, and it grows more resistant to acid\s
until it reaches immunity.
Green Dragons are elemental dragons of venom. They are not quite as strong as Red or White dragons,\s
but are still fearsome opponents. As they mature, their bites poison their enemies.\s
Green Dragons become more and more resistant to poison over time, eventually achieving immunity.
Shadow Drakes are among the stealthiest of dragons. They are creatures of nether,\s
and eventually evolve into Death Drakes and Spectral Wyrms. Their melee is the weakest among dragonkind and\s
their breaths are also somewhat lacking, but they still make fearsome opponents. As they advance,\s
these dragons gain the ability to pass through walls, and acquire several resistances including\s
immunity to nether.
Law Drakes are powerful dragons of order. They can breathe sound or shards and eventually\s
evolve into Great Wyrms of Law, though not as quickly as you might hope. Their breaths\s
are much weaker than those of the elemental dragons, but far fewer monsters resist sound\s
or shards. Their melee is also on the weak side by dragon standards, but most lesser creatures\s
would be quite happy with it!
Chaos Drakes are powerful dragons of chaos. They can breathe chaos or disenchantment and eventually\s
evolve into Great Wyrms of Chaos, though not as quickly as you might hope. Their breaths\s
are much weaker than those of the elemental dragons, but far fewer monsters resist chaos\s
or disenchantment; and though their melee is weak for a dragon, by more typical standards\s
they fight quite well.
Balance Drakes are a blend of Chaos and Law Drakes. They can breathe sound, shards,\s
chaos or disenchantment and eventually evolve into Great Wyrms of Balance.\s
Their breaths and attacks are weaker than those of Chaos and Law Drakes, but not by much.
Ethereal Drakes are dragons of light and darkness. They begin life as modest Pseudo\s
Dragons, but quickly evolve into Ethereal Drakes and then Ethereal Dragons. As they\s
mature, they gain the ability to pass through walls and become more and more resistant\s
to light, darkness and confusion. They are fairly weak fighters and have the weakest\s
breaths in all of dragonkind, except for Steel Dragons which cannot breathe at all.
Crystal Drakes are dragons of a strange crystalline form. They breathe shards and fight\s
powerfully with their razor-sharp claws and teeth. At high levels, they gain the power of\s
Bronze Dragons are wyrms of perplexity. While they are not quite as strong as most other\s
dragons, they eventually confuse monsters with their bite attack; also, they become\s
more and more resistant to confusion as they mature.
Gold Dragons are wyrms of sound. While they are not quite as strong as most other\s
dragons, they are able to breathe sound on command, stunning their foes; also, they become\s
more and more resistant to sound as they mature.
Steel Dragons are magical dragons formed from rock. As they mature, their form hardens\s
from stone into steel. Needless to say, their armor class is phenomenal, but their\s
dexterity actually decreases with maturity. Steel dragons begin life being susceptible\s
to cold damage, though they will eventually outgrow this vulnerability. They are not\s
as fast as other dragons and have no powers whatsoever, not even the ubiquitous\s
dragon breath! But their fighting is impossibly strong, putting all the other dragons\s
to complete and utter shame. They also have extremely high hitpoints.
Elementals are mindless creatures animated from a single\s
elemental form. As a species, elementals can never be cut,\s
and being virtually mindless they are immune to sanity blasting.\s
They rarely feel fear, and are resistant to confusion and poison. In addition, they\s
gain specific powers and abilities depending on their form.\n \n
Earth Elementals are slow, but gain AC bonuses due to their tough bodies.\s
They are resistant to shards, and may even turn their skins to stone.\s
At home in elemental earth, they may travel freely through rocky confines.\s
Unfortunately, as they are made of earth, their magic potions frequently turn to mud!\n \n
Air Elementals are shockingly fast, but perhaps that is just the\s
crackle of their electrified bodies? They may hurl bolts and balls of\s
electricity at their enemies, and may even imbue their weapons with\s
deadly lightning. However, being surrounded by lightning, rings,\s
amulets, wands and rods are quickly destroyed!\n \n
Fire Elementals are somewhat fast (enough to run circles around\s
their earthen brethren) and are cloaked in flames. They may attack\s
with hell's fury, but need to be on the lookout for cold-wielding foes.\s
Being surrounded by fire, they rapidly burn scrolls and staves to ash!\n \n
Finally, there are the Water Elementals, creatures able to conjure deadly\s
water bolts. They are immune to stunning. Their attacks can be quite corrosive;\s
but alas, sometimes their own armor corrodes as well. Water Elementals also have a unique\s
energy system based on the speed of their internal water flow; fighting and\s
the use of elemental powers excite them and turn them into a raging torrent,\s
while resting or aimlessly splashing about slows them down again. High flow\s
rates make water elementals stronger, but their armor sometimes gets caught in\s
the flow and slips off!
Earth Elementals are creatures of rock: Strong, tough and slow.\s
They may move freely through the earth and are capable of conjuring\s
sharp clods of earth to hurl at their foes. Their skin is very tough,\s
and they can even turn their bodies to stone. However, being made of\s
earth, their potions frequently turn to mud.
Air Elementals are creatures of electricity. They are incredibly fast,\s
blinking in and out of sight as they shower their enemies with confusing\s
and shocking blows. Electricity crackles menacingly about their nimble frames,\s
tending to destroy rings, amulets, wands and rods.
Water Elementals are creatures of water, able to modify this ubiquitous\s
liquid into a deadly and often corrosive weapon of destruction. Fear their\s
rage! They cannot be stunned. Their corrosive nature erodes any armor that\s
gets too close.
Fire Elementals are creatures of flame. They have a vast arsenal of\s
flaming attacks with which to singe the fiercest of foes. However, they\s
must beware of cold based attacks! Being wreathed in flames, scrolls and\s
staves are quickly burned to ash.
Beholders are floating orbs of flesh with a single central eye surrounded by\s
numerous smaller eyestalks. They attack with their gaze which often confuses or\s
even paralyzes their foes. They are unable to wield normal weapons or armor, but\s
may equip a single ring on each of their eyestalks, and the number of eyestalks\s
increases as the beholder evolves.\n \n
Beholders gain powers as they evolve, including some strong offensive spells;\s
but their primary offense will always be their powerful gaze. Intelligence is their\s
spell stat, and beholders are quite intelligent indeed. Their searching and\s
perception are legendary, and they are quite capable with magical devices.\s
However, they are not very strong and must be careful when surrounded by\s
foes.\n \n
The attack of the beholder is unique. Since their gaze is not a normal physical\s
attack, they receive no benefit to melee from their Strength and Dexterity. Also,\s
the number of attacks is determined by level rather than the normal way: in this\s
respect, they resemble monks. Finally, the beholder need not be next to their foes\s
in order to attack with melee; they may gaze at distant monsters, though the range\s
of their gaze is somewhat restricted, and prolonged long-distant gazing will tire them out.
Giants are humanoids of immense stature. There are several types of giants.\s
Fire, Frost and Storm giants are elemental giants, and gain elemental resistances,\s
slays and even attacks appropriate for their type. Titans are powerful immortal beings of legend;\s
their attacks often confuse their foes, and they rarely fight alone. Finally, there are the mighty\s
Hrus; they are so strong they can eventually crush the walls in their path, but their magical\s
powers are fairly limited.\n \n
Giants rely on their superior physical stature to pummel their opponents with mighty blows. Against a distant\s
foe, giants are capable of hurling large boulders with devastating effect.\s
Giants use the same equipment slots as most normal player races, and have no innate attacks.
Fire Giants are massive giants of flame. At high levels they become\s
wreathed in flames, and even their weapons will burn their foes. Like\s
all giants, they may toss loose rubble at their foes. In addition,\s
they have a few fire-based distance attacks up their sleeves.
Frost Giants are massive giants of ice. At high levels they become\s
wreathed in cold, and even their weapons will freeze their foes. Like\s
they have a few cold-based distance attacks up their sleeves.
Storm Giants are massive giants of lightning. At high levels they become\s
wreathed in electricity, and even their weapons will shock their foes. Like\s
they have a few lightning-based distance attacks up their sleeves.
Titans are huge immortal beings of incredible strength and awesome power.\s
Descended from Gaia and Uranus, they ruled during the legendary Golden Age,\s
but were overthrown by the Olympians during the War of the Titans.
Hrus are rock giants, made of stone. Their hides are tough and they are able\s
to break through walls effortlessly. Hrus are incredibly strong, but lack\s
much in the way of magical powers.
Golems are creatures animated by powerful magics: living stone conjured\s
to serve their creators. But you have broken loose and are running amok!\n \n
Golems are very slow when it comes to moving about; their non-movement actions\s
also tend to be slow, but not to the same extent. They excel in melee despite being limited to a\s
single (but mighty) blow; they can equip a weapon, but fight much better with their powerful fists.\s
Golems have a very high armor class and possess good resistances; they are also resistant to magic, and become\s
more resistant as they evolve, reducing the damage taken from all magical attacks.\n \n
There are several varieties of golem, all sharing a common evolutionary\s
heritage. First there is the mighty Colossus, the biggest (and slowest) of their\s
kind. Next is the Sky Golem, a creature of powerful magic, resistant to the\s
ravages of time. Finally, there is the Spellwarp Automaton, a creature of\s
utter destruction, almost completely immune to magic; unfortunately, this last form\s
takes nearly forever to build.
The Colossus is the biggest of all golems, truly immense.\s
Unfortunately, they are also the slowest of all golems on\s
account of their great size.
The Sky Golem is the product of powerful enchantments, resistant\s
to the ravages of time. They may even breathe time!
The Spellwarp Automaton is nearly indestructible, being\s
almost completely immune to magic. However, their great\s
power takes a seeming eternity to mature.
While Zephyr Hounds typically hunt in packs, you have chosen to go it alone.\s
You will begin life in the weak form of a Clear Hound. As you mature,\s
you will take a number of evolutionary steps. At each such step, the\s
form you evolve into will usually be randomly determined; but each tier offers\s
more powerful choices than the last, and you may guide your final evolution.\n \n
Hounds are not magical, and so cannot cast spells; however, they are\s
fantastic hunters, and learn a number of special abilities that will aid them\s
in this endeavour. And as you probably know all too well, hounds love to breathe!\n \n
Due to their canine bodies, Hounds cannot wield weapons; instead, they\s
attack with their vicious bite and razor-sharp claws. While their melee is\s
not as powerful as that of dragons, it usually gets the job done.\s
Hounds can wear four rings on their front paws, a pair of boots on their\s
hind legs, an amulet around their neck, and even a cloak and a suit of\s
body armor.
Hydras are monsters with multiple heads. As they evolve, they grow\s
additional heads, giving them extra attacks as well as the ability to\s
wear more equipment (helmets and amulets). While not every head may\s
wear a helmet and an amulet (imagine how powerful that would be!),\s
each head is capable of attacking; so an 11-headed hydra can attack\s
up to 11 times per round, provided it has enough strength\s
and dexterity to command such a fearsome arsenal.\n \n
Hydras are not very magical, and so play much like warriors but with a\s
few extra abilities. Five- and seven-headed hydras resist poison and gain a few poison-based attacks.\s
Nine- and eleven-headed hydras are creatures of flame: they resist fire, their attacks burn, and\s
they are capable of breathing fire among other flame-based attacks. All hydras\s
regenerate extremely rapidly.
Jellies are acidic creatures, quietly patrolling their surroundings in search\s
of objects to absorb. They are quite stealthy for most of their lives. They\s
don't wear equipment on their bodies the way normal races do; instead, they\s
are capable of absorbing objects into their gelatinous frames. In fact, each of their\s
equipment slots (except their pseudopod) is capable of holding any type of\s
equipment whatsoever, and the number of slots increases with experience.\s
For attacking, jellies are capable of forming a single pseudopod which they\s
may either use for grasping a normal melee weapon, or leave empty to use their\s
innate acid-based attacks.\n \n
Rather than relying on sight, jellies use a little-understood sense of their\s
surroundings which allows them to see in the dark with neither light nor infravision.\s
So while jellies can equip a torch or lantern, there is little reason for them to do so.\n \n
Jellies feed off the objects they find, gaining nutrition in proportion to the\s
weight of the object absorbed. They can eat rations of food if desired, but these\s
are so light as to offer very little nutritional value. Jellies prefer to eat heavy\s
armors and weapons. For convenience, destroyed objects are automatically eaten;\s
and jellies never become bloated, their appetite being insatiable.\n \n
Jellies begin life as a small puddle of black ooze, with very little carrying capacity for equipment.\s
However, they quickly evolve into a Gelatinous Cube and then into an Acidic Cytoplasm.\s
Jellies take one additional, powerful evolutionary step late in life.
Leprechauns are small, mischievous creatures, always scheming for gold.\s
They are weak, but quick and stealthy. For combat, they prefer not to use\s
weapons at all; rather, by keeping their weapon hand free, they may pilfer\s
objects or gold from their foes and flee to safety, all in a single action.\s
They are capable of fighting with normal weapons should the need arise, but\s
one seldom hears of leprechauns inspiring fear in combat!\n \n
Leprechauns value riches above all else, and even begin the game with their\s
legendary pot of gold. Leprechauns also have the luck of the Irish, and good\s
drops are more common for them. For magic, the leprechaun has a few talents,\s
even including some curses for offense; Malicious Leprechauns and Death Leprechauns are vile,\s
evil creatures, after all. They are masters of teleportation and detection; and while\s
their melee skills do not inspire much fear (except of poverty), they\s
are great masters of bow and device alike. At high levels, they move with incredible\s
speed and seem to be in multiple places at once. Dexterity determines the leprechaun's\s
skill with their magic.\n \n
A leprechaun uses gold for spellcasting the way most characters use mana. Gold is\s
also used to pay for recharging devices or to power mana branded weapons. In addition,\s
increasing the amount of gold on hand increases the power of the leprechaun, granting\s
extra blows per round, extra shots per round, and increased AC and life rating; sufficient gold even\s
increases the power of magical devices. Needless to say, greed is good when you're a leprechaun!
Liches are the undead forms of former sorcerers. Their magic is strong,\s
but their fighting skills weak. As undead, they quickly gain resistance to\s
cold, poison and nether, and these resistances increase as the lich\s
evolves.\n \n
Liches are born with magical powers, and gain additional powers as they advance; of all the\s
monster races, none can surpass the firepower of an Archlich, but managing\s
to evolve that far can be a challenge. Intelligence is their primary spell stat.\n \n
Liches are humanoid, and so use the standard set of equipment items; but should they\s
forgo the use of a normal weapon, they may touch their opponents for\s
various powerful effects. Even with this deadly touch, though, melee will\s
never be their strong suit.
Mimics are similar to Possessors; but instead of controlling the corpses of the\s
vanquished, the mimic imitates those about them. This allows the mimic to assume\s
the forms of foes they have yet to conquer, which is quite useful. However, there is\s
a small catch: mimics can only copy what they see! This limitation forces a\s
mimic to change forms much more often than a possessor would, as knowledge of their\s
current body rapidly fades when the original is no longer about. Occasionally, the\s
mimic is able to memorize a particular form well enough to use it again without the\s
original body to imitate, though this does not happen very often and the mimic can\s
only memorize a small number of forms. To have a chance of this, the mimic must be\s
in the desired form when slaying the original.\n \n
The stats, skills, spells, resistances and innate powers of a mimic are determined by the form they assume;\s
be sure to check both the racial power command (<color:keypress>U</color>/<color:keypress>O</color>) and the magic command (<color:keypress>m</color>) after assuming a new body.\s
The current form also determines the spell stat; for example, a novice priest mimic uses wisdom, while a novice mage mimic relies on intelligence.
Zombies and mummies are among the most feared of all undead races.\s
Evil curses are a mummy's bread and butter; not only can they hex their\s
opponents, they can also curse and uncurse their own equipment at will;\s
and the stronger and more numerous the curses they are wrapped in, the\s
greater their magical powers. Of course, they will also have to cope\s
with being cursed...\n\n
You begin unlife as a humble Zombified human, with few curses or other\s
abilities at your disposal; but soon you will evolve into a a\s
Mummified human, and things really start picking up. Mummy evolution is\s
somewhat random - you might find yourself a strong but stupid Draugr or a wily\s
but weak Mummified sorcerer - but ultimately, you will combine strength\s
and magic in the spine-chilling final form of a Mummy king.\n\n
Being creatures of tombs and the night, zombies and mummies can easily see\s
without a light; indeed, carrying a light source saps the dark energy of\s
their curses. In melee, they prefer to rely on their innate attacks;\s
equipping a weapon serves only to distract them from their real fighting\s
skills, and is only a viable offensive option in the earliest parts of the game.
Orcs are Morgoth's creation and the backbone of his armies. They are\s
accustomed to caves and tunnels, and resist darkness but tend to be\s
vulnerable to light. Orcs are ugly, brutish pillagers by reputation\s
and should not expect much love from shopkeepers. Morgoth's spirit\s
lives in orcs and drives them forward, making them hard to frighten.\s
What orcs lack in stealth and subtlety they make up for with their sheer\s
brute strength, and generally have little trouble brushing aside weak\s
enemies like kobolds; yet in the deep dungeons, where the strongest\s
fighters and most powerful magicians reside, orcs are rarely seen.
The most common and familiar type of orc, fighter orcs\s
are feared around the world for their strength, endurance,\s
brutality and low cunning. They start their careers as a\s
lowly Snaga, but will eventually develop into Uruk-hai or\s
even mighty warlords, capable of summoning and controlling\s
armies of lesser orcs.
Orc shamans and warlocks are more cunning than the average orc and\s
have learned rudimentary magic from their black masters.\s
They can detect threats, blink out of dangerous situations\s
and easily dispatch weak enemies with their offensive spells,\s
and are not quite as hopeless with magic devices as their\s
fighter kin, but like all orcs they tend to have trouble\s
when the going really gets tough.
The Possessor is an odd creature, completely harmless in its natural form. However, they\s
are capable of possessing the corpses of monsters they have slain, and gain powers and\s
abilities based on their current body. As such, they can become quite powerful indeed!\s
Unfortunately, not every type of monster will drop a corpse, and getting suitable corspes\s
to inhabit can be difficult. If the possessor ever leaves their current body, all of\s
their equipment will be removed (except a light source) and they will temporarily return\s
to their native, vulnerable state. Finally, leaving their current body will destroy that\s
corpse most of the time, so the possessor should only do so if they have a better corpse\s
on hand (and also only if there are no monsters nearby!). Possessors normally have full\s
control of the body they inhabit; but at very low health this control becomes hard to\s
maintain, and a possessor who suffers serious damage has a small chance of being ejected from the body.\n \n
The stats, skills, spells, resistances and innate powers of a possessor are determined by the body they inhabit;\s
be sure to check both the racial power command (<color:keypress>U</color>/<color:keypress>O</color>) and the magic command (<color:keypress>m</color>) after possessing a new body.\s
The current body also determines the spell stat; for example, a novice priest possessor uses wisdom, while a novice mage possessor relies on intelligence.
The creations of some differently normal scientist who thought sentient\s
blood-thirsty pumpkins would be a great idea, these creatures begin their lives\s
as pumpkin-headed humanoids; over time, however, the pumpkin bloats and crushes\s
the frail stick body underneath, leaving just a massive rolling fruit and an\s
unquenchable desire to kill. Death pumpkins lack most normal equipment slots,\s
but make up for it by the many lights they can store within their body.\s
Also, the bites of the deadliest pumpkins are said to be vampiric...
Quylthulgs are disgusting, quivering mounds of pulsating flesh, scarcely\s
able to move about. Physically, they are pathetic. However, their ability\s
to control others to do their bidding is legendary, and they are quite\s
capable of fleeing when the going gets tough. Quylthulgs have no physical\s
A pile of dirty, old, timeworn clothing, brought to life and sentience\s
by magic (or perhaps just by accumulating enough micro-organisms) and\s
filled with a strong desire to get back at all those clean, polished,\s
fashionable plate mails. Something, likely a thick layer of grime, has\s
permanently attached an old pair of boots and two plain leather gloves\s
to the original rag, allowing it to walk about and punch enemies. If\s
you think the thing looks ugly now, just wait until it's found some\s
other protective armour and has had the time to take it apart and\s
absorb its magical qualities...
Rings are sentient creatures animated by magical means.\n \n
Rings cannot wear normal equipment; rather, they simply are a ring,\s
magically enchanted. Rings have a small arsenal of innate powers. Since the ring\s
is unable to move on its own, it will need to lure a nearby monster\s
into wearing it. Magic rings tend to corrupt their owners, and over time,\s
the ring-bearer will find that his will is not his own!\n \n
Rings can absorb magic from the jewelry (rings or amulets) that they find,\s
and gain resistances, attributes and additional spells this way.\s
Rings have no physical attacks; instead, they may blast enemies with mighty\s
spells (once absorbed, of course), or they may simply lie back and let their\s
current bearer do the fighting for them.
Spiders are stealthy monsters that prefer to wait for their prey.\s
They have poisonous attacks and can weave sticky webs to entangle\s
their enemies. They have eight legs, enough for four rings and\s
two pairs of boots; they may also wear a helmet, an amulet, a cloak and\s
even a suit of body armor (after slight adjustments, of course), but\s
cannot wield a weapon or a bow. They also cannot equip light sources,\s
but this is not an issue, as spiders are accustomed to the dark.\n \n
There are two paths of evolution for the spider: the Phase Spider and\s
the Aranea. Araneas have greater fortitude and better stats, as well as\s
powerful melee capable of paralyzing an opponent; but Phase Spiders\s
compensate for their relative fragility with unsurpassed powers of teleportation.\n \n
All spiders begin in the very weak form of the Cave Spider. Lacking\s
any special talents, the cave spider must play carefully if it is to\s
Death-Swords are mighty weapons animated by magical means. As such,\s
they are unable to use equipment the way other players can; instead,\s
they simply are a weapon of their current form. But never fear: Death\s
Swords have the power to absorb magical essences from the weapons they\s
find, gaining power in the process.\n\n
As a Death-Sword gains levels, it will evolve into stronger and stronger weapons.\s
More advanced weapons require more essences to enchant, sometimes causing a\s
temporary loss of abilities; but magical weapons also become easier to\s
find as you descend deeper into the pits, and so any lost powers are usually\s
quickly recovered.
Ettins are large, two-headed trolls. They lack much in the way of\s
powers and abilities, but make up for this with the ability to\s
wield an extra helmet.
Storm Trolls are fast trolls with elemental powers. They may call\s
forth elemental balls and bolts. Their weapons are wreathed in\s
electricity as their fury rains down on all they meet.
Spirit trolls may pass through walls on their quest to demolish\s
all that oppose them.
Troll Kings are lords of their kind, fast and extremely deadly in\s
melee. They may blink themselves out of harm's way.
Trolls are disgusting creatures: big, strong and stupid. They make excellent warriors,\s
but are hopeless with magical devices. Trolls have incredible powers of regeneration.
One of the mightier undead creatures, the Vampire is an awe-inspiring sight. Yet this\s
dread creature has a serious weakness: the bright rays of sun are its bane, and it\s
will need to flee the surface to the deep recesses of earth until the sun finally\s
sets. Being undead, Vampires resist nether and have a firm hold on their life force;\s
vampires also resists cold and poison, and darkness only makes them feel at home.\s
Vampires are, however, susceptible to their\s
perpetual hunger for fresh blood, which can only be satiated by sucking blood\s
from a nearby monster.\n \n
Vampires gain access to various dark powers as they evolve. Of course, they gain a vampiric bite at a\s
very early stage, as they must use this power to feed on the living. Killing humans with this\s
power is also a means of perpetuating the vampire species, and many are the servants of a\s
true prince of darkness! Vampires are rumored to have limited shapeshifting abilities\s
and a powerful, hypnotic gaze.
You are a cloud of evil, sentient mist. As such you are incorporeal and are\s
unable to attack enemies directly. Conversely, you are resistant to material damage\s
and may pass through walls. Probably, you should run away upon assuming this form.
Vortices are mindless whirlwinds of elemental forces twirling their way\s
through the dungeon in search of prey. They are seldom confused\s
and never blinded since they lack vision in the normal sense; indeed, they\s
seem to be aware of their surroundings even without eyes, and need not wear a\s
light source. They can be neither stunned nor cut, and their mindless\s
nature renders them immune to fear. But, alas! they are hopeless with\s
magical devices and somewhat weak in melee; and while they may breathe\s
almost effortlessly, their breath attacks are not particularly strong.\n \n
Vortices do not have normal bodies; rather, they are simply a rapidly\s
spinning elemental mass. As such, they may incorporate objects into their\s
rotating essence, gaining bonuses and protection in the process.\s
The number of objects they may use increases with level, and there are no\s
restrictions on the types of equipment they may 'wield' in each slot.\s
While they may equip weapons this way, they cannot attack with them; instead,\s
vortex melee relies on their innate ability to engulf nearby monsters in the\s
whirling elements.\n \n
Vortices evolve randomly, though all seem to end up with the evolutionary\s
perfection of the Aether vortex. At level 50 they gain a special talent\s
to augment their power.
Xorns are massive creatures of earth. They begin life as an Umber Hulk, a bizarre\s
creature with large mandibles capable of slicing through rock and glaring eyes capable of confusing foes.\s
At this stage in their evolution their body is vaguely humanoid, allowing them to\s
wear a helmet, an amulet, a cloak and even a pair of boots; once the Umber Hulk evolves further, however,\s
it can no longer wear these items. Instead, a grown Xorn can use its four massive arms for weapons, shields, rings\s
and gloves; mature Xorns can also pass effortlessly through rock.\n \n
Xorns have no active magical powers, but instead rely on their ability to hide in rocks and the advantage that their\s
extra arms provide them in melee. Xorns, like most warrior characters, are very effective at killing monsters\s
but have problems with advanced magic devices.
The Amberites are a reputedly immortal race, who are endowed with numerous\s
advantages in addition to their longevity. They are very tough and their\s
constitution cannot be reduced, and their ability to recover from wounds\s
surpasses most other races. Having seen virtually everything, very\s
little is new to them, and so they gain levels relatively slowly.
An android is an artificial creation with a body of machinery. Their intelligence\s
almost matches that of organic races, though their wisdom is no better than that of\s
Golems. Of course, their mechanical body offers great physical advantages, far\s
surpassing the powers of man. Uniquely among all races, Androids do not acquire\s
experience from killing monsters, but rather gain in power as they attach new\s
equipment to their frame. Rings, amulets, and lights do not influence growth.\s
Androids are resistant to poison and immune to life-draining attacks; moreover,\s
because of their hard metallic bodies, they get a bonus to AC. Androids have\s
electronic circuits throughout their body, and so must beware of electric shocks.\s
They gain very little nutrition from the food of mortals, but can use flasks\s
of oil as their energy source.
Archons are a higher class of angels. They are good at all skills, and are strong,\s
wise, and a favorite with any people. They are able to see the unseen, and\s
their wings allow them to safely fly over traps and other dangerous places. However,\s
belonging to a higher plane as they do, the experiences of this world do not leave\s
a strong impression on them and they gain levels slowly.
Balrogs are a higher class of demons. They are strong, intelligent and tough, but\s
lacking in wisdom and not suitable for priesthood. Balrogs are resistant to\s
fire and nether, and have a firm hold on their life force; they also soon learn\s
to see invisible things. They are good at almost all skills except stealth. They gain\s
very little nutrition from the food of mortals, and need human corpses as sacrifices\s
to regain their vitality.
Barbarians are hardy men of the north; they are fierce in combat, and their wrath\s
is feared throughout the world. Combat is their life: they feel no fear, and they\s
learn to enter battle frenzy at will even sooner than half-trolls. Barbarians are,\s
however, suspicious of magic, which makes magic devices fairly hard for them to use.\s
Barbarians gain a demigod talent at level 30.
This race is a blasphemous abomination produced by Chaos. It is not an independent\s
race but rather a humanoid creature, most often a human, twisted by Chaos; or else\s
a nightmarish crossbreed of a human and a beast. All Beastmen are accustomed\s
to Chaos so much that they are untroubled by confusion and sound, although raw\s
Logrus can still hurt them. Beastmen revel in chaos, as it twists them\s
more and more. Beastmen are subject to mutations: when they have been created,\s
they receive a random mutation, and have a small chance to gain more mutations\s
every time they advance a level. Unlike normal races, Beastmen can have many\s
mutations without ill effects on their regeneration.
Boits are small bipedal creatures covered in yellow, lilac, brown or green\s
fur, distantly related to the Yeeks. Boits move speedily, and can eject\s
the contents of their stomachs at will, but they are not particularly\s
well-suited for melee, ranged combat, use of magical devices, or spellcasting.
Centaurs are creatures with the head, arms and torso of a human combined with the\s
body and legs of a horse. As such, they are able to move more quickly as\s
they gain experience and are capable of leaping great distances. Centaurs are\s
skilled in fighting and archery and can attack monsters with their hooves in\s
addition to normal melee weapons; but lacking normal feet, they cannot wear boots.\s
Being at home in the forests of the world, Centaurs\s
are able to move quickly through foliage.
With but one eye, a Cyclops can see more than many with two eyes. They are\s
headstrong, and loud noises bother them very little. They are not quite\s
qualified for the magic using professions, but as a certain Mr. Ulysses\s
can testify, their accuracy with thrown rocks can be deadly!
A cave-dwelling race unhampered by darkness attacks, dark-elves have more\s
in common with Nibelungs than with other elves. They have a great capacity\s
for magic and spellcasting, and learn the Magic Missile spell at a low level\s
regardless of their class. With their keen sight, they soon acquire the\s
ability to see invisible things.
Draconians are a humanoid race with dragon-like attributes. There are several\s
subtypes of draconians with different resistances, breaths and attributes;\s
for example, Red Draconians are resistant to fire which they may also breathe\s
at will, while White Draconians breathe and resist cold instead. All draconians\s
levitate. In addition, when they mature enough, they may choose a special\s
draconian power.
Red Draconians have an affinity for fire, which they both breathe at will and resist.\s
Together with their White kin, they are the strongest in combat of the draconians;\s
but they are not so good with magic, and their stealth is quite poor. Should they choose\s
the power of Dragon Skin, they will gain a fiery aura as well. Should they choose the\s
power of Dragon Strike, their blows will burn their enemies.
White Draconians have an affinity for frost, which they both breathe at will and resist.\s
Together with their Red kin, they are the strongest in combat of the draconians;\s
the power of Dragon Skin, they will gain an aura of cold as well. Should they choose the\s
power of Dragon Strike, their blows will freeze their enemies.
Blue Draconians have an affinity for lightning, which they both breathe at will\s
and resist. They are strong in combat, but not so good with magic or stealth.\s
Should they choose the power of Dragon Skin, they will gain a shocking aura as well.\s
Should they choose the power of Dragon Strike, their blows will electrocute\s
their enemies.
Black Draconians have an affinity for acid, which they both breathe at will\s
With the power of Dragon Strike, their blows will corrode their enemies.
Green Draconians have an affinity for poison, which they both breathe at will\s
and resist. They are average in all respects among the draconians. With the\s
power of Dragon Strike, their blows will poison their enemies.
Bronze Draconians are the most intelligent of their kind, and the best with\s
magic as well. They are seldom confused, though the same may not be said of\s
their enemies. With the power of Dragon Strike, even the melee attacks of\s
the Bronze Draconian will baffle their enemies.
Hard of skin, the Crystal Draconian is difficult to hit in melee; but their agility\s
suffers, and they are not the brightest of their kind. They resist shards, which they\s
may also breathe on command. With the power of Dragon Skin, they gain an aura of\s
shards as well. With the power of Dragon Strike, even their melee attacks will shred\s
The wisest of their kind, Gold Draconians are resilient in the face of magical\s
attacks. They are resistant to sound, which they may also breathe at will, stunning\s
their opponents. With the power of Dragon Strike, even their melee attacks will\s
stun enemies.
Lithe, stealthy and nimble, the Shadow Draconian is seldom seen in this world.\s
They are resistant to the forces of nether, which they may also breathe. They are the\s
weakest of the draconians, and the poorest in melee; but they are better than average\s
with magic. With the power of Dragon Strike, they may steal life from their enemies\s
in melee.
Dunedain are a race of hardy men from the West. This elder race surpasses human\s
abilities in every field; however, being men of the world,\s
very little is new to them, and levels are very hard for them to gain. Dunedain\s
gain one demigod talent at level 30. Their constitution\s
is exceptionally good and cannot be reduced.
Dwarves are the headstrong miners and fighters of legend. They tend to be strong and tough,\s
but lack agility. Because they are so headstrong and also somewhat wise, dwarves are\s
relatively resistant to evil curses cast on them. They are very good at fighting, searching\s
and perception, and resist being blinded, but infamously have miserable stealth.
Dead heroes returning to the mortal world for one last fight, Einherjar are highly\s
skilled in hand-to-hand combat and start with the ability to enter a battle frenzy;\s
however, they are also passably good at using devices, and do not necessarily make\s
weak magic users. Already having one lifetime's adventures behind them, Einherjar are\s
very strong at the beginning but learn new things slowly. Like other undead races, they\s
are immune to life draining. Einherjar have one serious weakness: magical healing only\s
has a partial effect on them, healing them half as much as it would any other race.
The Ents are a powerful race dating from the beginning of the world, oldest of all\s
animals or plants who inhabit Arda. Spirits of the land, they guard the forests\s
of Middle-earth. Being much like trees, they are strong but very clumsy, and\s
highly susceptible to fire. Ents gain nourishment from drinking water;\s
the food of mortals is of little use to them. Ents have the special ability to\s
summon the trees of the forest to their side.
Gnomes are smaller than dwarves but larger than hobbits; and like hobbits, they\s
live in the earth in burrow-like homes. Gnomes make excellent mages, and have very\s
good saving throws. They are naturally skilled at most things, but not very strong\s
or good at hand-to-hand fighting. Gnomes have fair infra-vision, allowing them to\s
detect warm-blooded creatures at a distance. They are also intrinsically protected\s
against paralysis.
A Golem is an artificial creature, built from a lifeless raw material like clay,\s
and awakened to life. They are nearly mindless, making them useless for\s
professions which rely on magic, but as warriors they are very tough. They\s
are resistant to poison and paralysis and can see invisible things.\s
At higher levels, they also become resistant to attacks which threaten to\s
drain away their life force. Golems gain very little nutrition from ordinary\s
food, but can absorb mana from staves and wands as their power source. Golems\s
also gain a natural armor class bonus from their tough body. Golems become\s
slower with age.
Half-giants' limited intelligence makes it difficult for them to become full spellcasters,\s
but with their huge strength they make excellent warriors. Their thick skin makes\s
them resistant to shards, and like half-trolls, they have their strength sustained.
Half-orcs make excellent warriors, but are terrible at magic.\s
They are as bad as dwarves at stealth, and horrible at searching,\s
disarming, and perception. Being accustomed to living underground,\s
half-orcs are resistant to darkness attacks. Half-orcs are quite ugly,\s
and so tend to pay more for goods in town. The human part of their\s
heritage allows them to select a talent at level 30.
Half-mortal descendants of the mighty titans, these immensely powerful creatures\s
put almost any other race to shame. They may lack the fascinating special powers\s
some other races have, but their enhanced attributes more than make up for that.\s
They learn to estimate the strengths of their foes, and their love for law and\s
order makes them resistant to the effects of Chaos.
Half-trolls are incredibly strong, and have more hit points than most other races.\s
They are very stupid, and bad at searching, disarming, perception, and stealth;\s
but they make excellent fighters despite their poor agility. They are so ugly that a\s
half-orc grimaces in their presence. They also happen to be fun to run...\s
Half-trolls always have their strength sustained, and their regeneration is exceptionally fast.
High-elves are a race of immortal beings dating from the beginning of time.\s
They are masters of all skills, and are strong and intelligent, although\s
their wisdom is sometimes suspect. High-elves begin their lives able to\s
see the unseen, and resist light effects just like regular elves. However,\s
there are few things that they have not seen already, so new levels are\s
quite hard for them to gain.
Hobbits (or Halflings) have exceptional stealth and are very good at bows\s
and throwing; indeed, they are generally well-suited for the adventuring life.\s
Yet their small size is a handicap at times; they are not very good at melee\s
fighting, and cannot suffer as many hard hits as larger races. Hobbits are\s
known for their love of good cooking, and have an almost miraculous ability\s
to find food in the dark depths of the dungeon.
Humans are average at everything, and tend to gain levels rapidly due\s
to their short life spans. No racial adjustments or intrinsics occur\s
to characters choosing human. Humans receive one special talent at\s
level 20, which helps make up for their apparent mediocrity; but at\s
level 35 they acquire a special human weakness. See\s
<link:Demigods.txt#Weaknesses> for more information.
A demon-creature from the nether-world, naturally resistant to fire attacks,\s
and capable of learning fire bolt and fire ball attacks. They are little\s
loved by other races, but can perform fairly well in most professions.\s
As they advance levels, they gain the ability to perceive invisible creatures.
Klackons are bizarre semi-intelligent ant-like insectoid creatures.\s
They make great fighters, but their mental abilities are severely limited.\s
Obedient and well-ordered, they are resistant to confusion. They are very\s
nimble, and become faster as they advance levels. They are also very acidic,\s
inherently resist acid, and become capable of spitting it at higher levels.
Kobolds are a weak goblin race. They love poisoned weapons, and can learn to throw\s
poisoned darts (of which they carry an unlimited supply). They are also inherently\s
resistant to poison.
A Kutar is not a dog, cat or bear. Despite their characteristic\s
vacant expression, Kutars are beautiful and so have a high charisma.\s
Their absent-mindedness hurts their searching and perception skills,\s
but renders them resistant to being confused. Due to their unearthly\s
calmness and serenity, Kutars are extremely stealthy. They learn the\s
special ability to expand their body horizontally; this increases\s
their armour class, but renders them vulnerable to curses.
Mindflayers are a secretive and mysterious ancient race. Their civilization may well\s
be older than any other; their intelligence and wisdom are naturally sustained,\s
and so great as to make Mindflayers highly effective spellcasters, but their\s
physical attributes are a good deal less admirable. As they gain levels, they\s
learn to see invisible creatures, and eventually develop a telepathic sight.
The hated and persecuted race of nocturnal dwarves, these cave-dwellers are\s
not much bothered by darkness. Their natural inclination to magical items\s
has made them resistant to effects which could disenchant magical energy.
Ogres are big and ugly, but possessed of a low cunning and great strength.\s
They have all the necessary attributes to be warriors, yet are also\s
surprisingly adept as mages; and at high level, all Ogres learn the Ogre\s
Mage skill of setting trapped runes. Being simple-minded, Ogres have their\s
intelligence sustained.
Shadow-fairies are one of the several fairy races. They have wings, and can fly over\s
traps that may open up beneath them. Being creatures of darkness, shadow-fairies are\s
vulnerable to bright light. They are physically weak, but naturally adept at using\s
magic. Shadow-fairies are amazingly stealthy, and have a wonderful advantage in\s
that they almost never aggravate monsters; aggravating equipment only gives them a slight\s
penalty to stealth, but if they have an aggravating personality the advantage is lost.
As undead beings, skeletons need worry very little about poison or attacks\s
that can drain life. Skeletons do not really use eyes for perceiving things,\s
and are thus not fooled by invisibility. Their bones are resistant to sharp shrapnel,\s
and they will quickly become resistant to cold. Although the magical effects of\s
potions and mushrooms will affect the skeleton even without entering its (non-existent)\s
belly, the food itself will fall through the skeleton's jaws, giving no nutritional benefit;\s
instead, skeletons feed themselves by absorbing the energy of magical devices.
Snotlings are greenskins, and are cousins of Goblins and Orcs, smaller than the\s
former and dumber than the latter, often used by them as cannon fodder, food\s
or even cannon missiles. They are on the lowest rung of greenskin society and\s
are bullied by all. Snotlings often wield mushrooms or sticks into battle.
A powerful undead creature, the Spectre is a ghastly apparition, surrounded by\s
an unearthly green glow. Spectres exist only partially on our plane of existence:\s
half-corporeal, they can pass through walls, although the density of the wall\s
will hurt them in the process of doing this. As undead, they have a firm hold\s
on their life force, can see invisible creatures, and resist poison, cold and\s
nether. Spectres make superb spellcasters, but their physical form is very weak.\s
They gain very little nutrition from the food of mortals, but can absorb mana\s
from magical devices as their energy source.
One of the several fairy races, Sprites are very small. They have tiny wings and can\s
fly over traps that may open up beneath them. They enjoy sunlight intensely, and\s
need worry little about light based attacks. Although physically among the weakest\s
races, Sprites are very talented in magic, and can become highly skilled wizards.\s
Sprites have the special power of spraying Sleeping Dust, and at higher levels they\s
learn to fly faster.
Smaller and of lighter build than regular elves, Tomtes are nimble, intelligent,\s
extremely stealthy and at home with magical devices, but their size handicaps them\s
in physical combat. They greatly prefer light headwear, and cannot think clearly\s
with a heavy helmet squeezing their brains. Tomtes have the ability to assess\s
monsters and items at a glance (they gain auto-identify at level 40); and being\s
accustomed to long winters, they are not much bothered by cold.
Tonberries are lizard-like creatures who possess enormous strength\s
and have a preference for cleavers and large knives. They are,\s
however, sluggish in their movements and reactions; young and\s
inexperienced tonberries are often preyed on by the other races.\s
They possess human-like intelligence, but rarely become mages due\s
to their culture and physiology. Tonberries attack very powerfully\s
in melee, albeit with fewer attacks than normal. They are also\s
easily confused and move with reduced speed.
One of the mightier undead creatures, the vampire is an awe-inspiring sight. Yet this\s
sets. Darkness, on the other hand, holds few terrors to a vampire. Being undead,\s
vampires also resist nether, cold and poison and have a firm hold on their life force;\s
but they are susceptible to a perpetual hunger for fresh blood, which can only be\s
satiated by sucking the blood from a nearby monster.
Wood-Elves are the most common of elves. They prefer the seclusion of thick\s
forests and are unhampered when moving through dense foliage. Their skills\s
with tracking and bow are unsurpassed, and as they advance they gain the\s
power of Nature Awareness.
Yeeks are among the most pathetic creatures. Fortunately, their horrible screams\s
can scare away less confident foes, and their skin becomes more and more resistant\s
to acid as they gain experience. They are also fairly good at magic; but in combat,\s
even a mediocre monster can wipe the proverbial floor with an unwary Yeek.
Zombies are undead horrors, resistant to life draining and the forces\s
of the netherworld. The grave is cold, but this does not bother the undead, and\s
poison also scarcely affects the unliving. Zombies gain little nutrition from\s
ordinary food; instead, they absorb energy from magical devices to maintain\s
their undead existence.
Mangy Lepers are humans who have contracted a horrible wasting disease.\s
You cannot help but feel disgusted as your body rots before your very\s
Small Kobolds are a the runts of the kobold race, often relegated to the\s
performance of menial tasks deemed unworthy of their larger, more\s
respectable brethren.
Rage-Mages are part of a secret sect, originally founded by Barbarians in\s
response to their natural foes, the mages. With the passing of time, other\s
races have also begun to study these arts.\n\n
Rage techniques are learned from books, but differ from normal spells in many ways.\s
First of all, the Rage-Mage must perform a special Ritual of Anger to\s
learn a power, and this ritual destroys the book; as a result, it may take\s
a long time for the Rage-Mage to learn all of their high-level powers.\s
Books are required only for learning; the powers, once learned, can be\s
used without them.\n\n
Another unique aspect of Rage-Mages concerns their mana pool. Rage-Mage\s
mana, unlike that of normal spellcasters, does not regenerate on its own;\s
in fact, it actually decreases rapidly each turn, meaning Rage-Mages had\s
better use their powers quickly while they still can. A Rage-Mage gains\s
mana whenever he is the target of a magical spell; indeed, magic makes a\s
Rage-Mage very angry! Rage-Mages can also fuel their mana by hurting\s
those around them, which can be quite effective in crowded situations.
A Ranger is a seasoned wanderer from the plains or woods, attuned\s
to the natural world. Rangers have few weak points; like mages they\s
are excellent with magic devices, yet they are also fairly good\s
at using bows and melee weapons. Their stealth, searching and\s
perception have been sharpened by their time in the wilderness,\s
and their alliance with the spirits of nature even gives them a\s
good saving throw.\n \n
All rangers are trained in Nature magic, and all Nature spells are\s
available to them; they even learn these spells almost as fast as\s
mages. They can also select a secondary realm (Sorcery,\s
Chaos, Death, Trump, Arcane, and Daemon); but they are slow\s
learners here, and may find themselves unable to learn some of the\s
highest level spells. Another downside is that rangers, like the\s
priestly classes, lack the ability to choose their own spells;\s
they will learn whatever the capricious nature gods choose to teach them.\n\n
Rangers have a class power, 'Probe Monster',\s
which allows them to assess the strengths and weaknesses of the\s
monsters they meet. The magical powers of a ranger depend on Wisdom.
Red-Mages make better fighters than most mages, and are also\s
versatile spellcasters who can use many realms without needing\s
to specialize in only one or two. The downside of this wide scope is\s
that Red-Mages' magic is fairly shallow; they have high fail rates,\s
minimum levels and mana costs, and are limited to the first two\s
spellbooks in each realm except for Arcane.\n\n
Red-Mages have a class power, 'Double Magic', which allows them to\s
cast two spells at once. As with regular mages, their spellcasting stat\s
is Intelligence.
A Rogue is a character who prefers to live by their cunning, yet is\s
capable of fighting their way out of a tight spot when necessary. Rogues\s
are good at locating secret doors and hidden traps, and are masters of\s
trap-disarming and lockpicking. Their exceptional stealth allows\s
rogues to sneak around sleeping creatures without having to fight;\s
they can also backstab a fleeing monster or surprise an\s
enemy with a telling first blow. Rogues are fairly good at ranged combat,\s
and receive special bonuses when shooting with a sling.\n \n
Rogues can select one realm - Sorcery, Death, Trump, Arcane, Craft, Law,\s
or Burglary. Except for this last realm, rogues have certain limitations\s
on which spells they can learn, and they do not learn new spells very quickly.\s
The Burglary realm is unique to the rogue, and the speciality of the class; it\s
offers spells for setting traps, picking pockets, negotiating with\s
other thieves, and escaping from a tight spot. Burglary rogues are\s
agents of the Black Market and receive favorable pricing from\s
that shop. Burglary rogues use Dexterity as their spellcasting stat,\s
and can use this special art from the beginning of their adventures; rogues of other\s
realms, however, rely on Intelligence and cannot learn magic spells before they\s
reach level 5.
Augment your equipment by attaching runes of various powers. Also, you may create\s
certain stand-alone runes that grant powers by virtue of being present in your\s
inventory. Be sure to always keep Absorption handy, for it is your only means\s
of regaining spell points!
These runes allow you to effect adjacent enemies. By creating a temporary rune\s
attached to your melee weapon, you may make a single attack with enhanced power.
The Rune-Knight is a mythical warrior,\s
dedicated to the discovery of ancient runes that hold immense power. They\s
may fix mystical runes of various types to their equipment in order to\s
gain permanent bonuses; even artifacts can be improved this way!\s
Alternatively, they may conjure a temporary rune which allows\s
them to attack with enhanced effects, or place one directly on\s
their person for a one-time or temporary bonus.\s
Finally, they may alter their surroundings with various runes of\s
change.\n \n
All runes (except <color:B>{Absorption}</color>) require mana for\s
creation; however, unlike ordinary spellcasters, Rune-Knights do not\s
regenerate mana on their own. Rather, they must siphon mana from\s
magical or elemental attacks directed against them, and doing so\s
requires the special rune of <color:B>{Absorption}</color>. This\s
rune should be worn at all times, or at least kept handy.\n \n
Despite having mana, the Rune-Knight does not play like an ordinary\s
spellcaster; they are more like a weaponsmith but can, on occasion,\s
cast useful spells. If you have mana available, consider using these\s
spells; otherwise, play as a warrior and wait to absorb mana. This\s
can take time, depending on the foes you face, but the Rune-Knight's\s
honor should prevent them from seeking out weak, defenseless spellcasters;\s
and in any case, weak attacks can only take your mana so high.
Samurai, masters of the art of the blade, are among the strongest\s
fighters and can use various special combat techniques.\s
Samurai are not good at most non-combat skills, and many\s
magical devices in particular may be too difficult for them to use.\s
Wisdom determines a Samurai's ability to use the special combat\s
techniques available.\n \n
Samurai use the art of the blade called Kendo (or Bugei). Books\s
of Kendo are similar to spellbooks, but do not need to be carried\s
around; they are only required for studying new combat techniques.\s
Samurai need to wield a weapon to use Kendo, and many of their techniques will\s
add special properties to their blows; these are often slays or brands such as\s
flaming or poisoning, but can be much more powerful than a normal brand.\s
The mana pool of a Samurai does not depend on their level but\s
solely on wisdom; and they can use the class power 'Concentration'\s
to temporarily increase their mana beyond its usual maximum value. The other\s
Samurai class power, 'Assume a Posture', allows them to choose\s
different postures depending on the needs of a situation.

The scout is the vanguard of any attack, and excels at stealth and observation\s
skills. Scouts are not the best at one-on-one combat, but are unparalleled at\s
ambush techniques for destroying groups of weak sentries. Scouts are lightly\s
armored, and heavy armor disrupts their abilities. Unlike most characters,\s
scouts are not at home in cramped corridors; in open areas they can\s
dodge attacks effectively, but being confined severely hampers their\s
defensive abilities.

<color:B>Melee</color> skills increase your ability to fight monsters in hand to hand combat.\s
The total number of points spent in this group will determine your base fighting\s
skill, as well as how much melee skill you gain with experience. In addition, this\s
total gives bonuses to STR and DEX. The individual skills determine your base\s
proficiency with the given type of weapon, as well as the maximum number of blows\s
per round you may gain. For martial arts, the number of points determines your\s
effective fighting level which is used to determine which types of hits you land.
<color:B>Ranged</color> skills increase your ability to fight monsters using distance weapons\s
such as bows and slings, as well as the ability to throw melee weapons\s
effectively. The total number of points spent in this group will determine\s
your base shooting skill, as well as how fast this skill increases with\s
experience. Archery grants proficiency with the various classes of shooters\s
as well as increasing your number of shots per round. Throwing grants the power\s
to throw your leading melee weapon and perhaps have it return to you as well.
<color:B>Magic</color> skills grant access to various spellcasting realms using INT rather\s
than WIS as the spellcasting stat. Each point in a given realm increases\s
your maximum spellcasting level as well as the decreasing the cost and fail\s
rates of individual spells. You need not learn individual spells the way a\s
mage might. Rather, you may cast any spell in a known realm provided your\s
spellcasting level is high enough. The total number of points spent in this\s
group provides a modest boost to device skills as well as increasing your\s
INT. Unfortunately. this total also has a negative impact on your life rating,\s
STR and CON.
<color:B>Prayer</color> skills work like Magic skills, granting access to various realms of\s
magic. However, prayer realms use WIS for the spellcasting stat rather than\s
INT. Moreover, the total points in the Prayer group grants enhanced saving\s
throws as well as increased WIS, but does not affect device skills or life\s
rating. As in Magic, the number of points invested in a particular realm\s
determines your maximum casting level and also influences casting costs and\s
fail rates. Life magic is only available as a Prayer talent. The other prayer\s
realms are duplicated as Magic talents, but you can only learn them in one\s
way: as either INT based or WIS based.
There are various <color:B>Skills</color> important for every player, including\s
stealth, perception, health and magic devices. While these skills may be influenced by\s
talents in other groups (e.g. Magic increases your device skills), it is often\s
desirable to directly increase these skills even more. In addition, you can directly\s
improve your starting stats by investing in some of the skills in this group\s
(e.g. Agility improves DEX while Health improve CON).
There are various specialty <color:B>Techniques</color> which you may want to\s
learn, including the Riding and Dual Wielding talents, as well as access to the\s
Burglary and Kendo techniques. These latter two function like spell realms, using\s
DEX and WIS respectively as their primary spell stat. Kendo also makes your mana\s
function like that of the Samurai, and this behavior is used no matter what other\s
Magic or Prayer realms you have learned. Note that Kendo still requires you to\s
carry the appropriate spellbooks since you really are not samurai.
Many <color:B>Abilities</color> can be purchased for a single skill point. Often\s
these grant an extra power which you may activate at will without cost, and usually\s
without fail. Alternatively, abilities may grant a bonus such as regeneration or\s
good fortune.

Are you sure you want to do this? The skills you learn are permanent choices and you\s

You must choose which <color:B>skills</color> to learn. The various skills are grouped\s
into categories. Often, the total number of points in a given group determines broad level\s
skills and perhaps grants boosts to your starting stats, while the specific skill points\s
grant targetted benefits (such as proficiency with a class of weapons, or access to\s
a specific spell realm). Details are given in the submenu for each group. Feel free to\s
explore the various groups since you may always <color:keypress>ESC</color> to return here.\n\n
The Skillmaster is not your ordinary class. Instead, you\s
may design your own class, on the fly, using a point-based\s
skill system. Upon birth, you will get 5 points to spend;\s
use them wisely to set the basic direction of your class.\s
Every fifth character level, you will\s
receive an additional point to spend, for fifteen points\s
overall. You may use these points to learn melee, to\s
master a spell realm, to improve your speed or stealth,\s
to increase your magic device skills, to gain special\s
techniques, to learn riding, dual-wielding or martial\s
arts... no other class, even Psion or Yeqrezh Disciple,\s
offers as much flexibility.\n\n
Most skills allow the investment of multiple points for\s
increased proficiency, but some are abilities that you may\s
buy with a single point (e.g. Luck). This class is not recommended for\s
beginning players, despite being quite strong; you only have a limited\s
amount of points to spend, and your choices are irreversible.

Concentrate your mind for more powerful shooting. As you increase\s
your focus, you will gain access to more deadly archery techniques.\s
In addition, you will land more critical shots as your aim improves.
Shoot a glowing arrow that lights up the dungeon. This\s
shot also does increased damage from light against\s
enemies that are hurt by bright light.
Snipers are specialists in marksmanship, but not like archers who\s
fire off arrow after arrow in swift succession. They don't just\s
increase accuracy and power of shots by concentration, they can use\s
fearsome archery techniques.\n \n
What they require is powerful bows or crossbows, good quality\s
ammunition and the fortitude to bear up without flinching under\s
any situation.\n \n
Snipers know their enemies well and can shoot them from the shadows.\s
They have no time for magic.
Sorcerers are the all-around best magicians, being able to master\s
all spells from almost any magic realm without needing to study them or\s
gain proficiency with them. On the downside, they have by far the\s
fewest hit points of any class; they are also the worst fighters in the\s
dungeon, being unable to use any weapon but a Wizardstaff.\n \n
Sorcerers have a class power - 'Eat Magic' - which absorbs mana from\s
wands, staves or rods. Unlike other mages, they rely on Charisma as\s
their spell stat.
Fires a temporal bolt at chosen foe. Time based attacks may produce various\s
effects on a monster including slowing, stasis, and many others.

Time-Lords are masters of temporal magic, altering the flow of time\s
to their advantage. They gain new powers as their experience grows,\s
and are unique in their ability to use time-based spells against monsters.\s
Not only do these attacks damage a foe, they also inflict a wide variety of possible effects,\s
from slowing to amnesia, from evolution to devolution, from weakening to stasis.\s
In addition to temporal attacks, Time-Lords gain great powers of speed, and\s
become naturally faster with experience. Legend has it that masters of time can even see\s
into the future, avoiding attacks that would otherwise prove fatal!\n \n
Time-Lords are fairly proficient with magical devices, but are mediocre fighters and not\s
good at archery at all. At high levels, they become resistant to time.\s
Time-Lords' primary stat is Wisdom.
Tourists have visited this world for the purpose of sightseeing.\s
Their fighting skills are bad, and they cannot cast powerful\s
spells. They are the most difficult class to win the game with.\s
Intelligence determines a tourist's spellcasting ability.\n \n
Tourists are always seeing more of the world to add to their stock\s
of information; no other class can compete with their\s
identification skills. They have two class powers - 'Take a\s
Photograph' and 'Identify True'. Their magic is based on Arcane,\s
and - aside from identify - is very weak indeed.
The Troika is a group of three closely related Purples working together -\s
Guntujant, Uxip and Sohoglyth. Guntujant is a capricious Purple who follows\s
the careers of his servants very closely, and rewards and punishes them\s
seemingly at random; the powers gained by his followers are unpredictable,\s
but generally quite strong. Uxip delights in combat, and grants Troika\s
disciples their prodigious endurance and skill with two-handed weapons;\s
however, a number of common items are an abomination unto Uxip, and cannot\s
be used by followers of the Troika. Sohoglyth is a mysterious spirit, but\s
a profoundly powerful one. She occasionally sets bonus quests for Troika\s
disciples; if enough of the quests are completed with no failures, she will\s
reward the questor with the power of telepathy, remote object quality\s
sensing, or even walking through walls.\n\n
Troika Disciples are in general very strong, especially in combat but also\s
sorcery, yet the limitations placed upon them by Uxip and Guntujant also make\s
them in some ways vulnerable. In particular, they frequently suffer random\s
punishments, risk being punished if they teleport from a fight while not at low health,\s
cannot wear a shield or cure poison with mushrooms, and must earn the right to\s
use a rod of Detection. The spells of Troika disciples are unique in that they\s
are not learned at any particular character level; instead, Guntujant and Uxip\s
will teach them as a reward for killing dangerous enemies, especially uniques.\s
Strength determines the spellcasting ability of a Troika disciple.
